translations.literal: Treatise 51
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 51

sentences.zh: 地理二十三

translations.literal: Geography 23
translations.idiomatic: Geography 23

sentences.zh: 新疆

translations.literal: Xinjiang
translations.idiomatic: Xinjiang

sentences.zh: 新疆：古雍州域外西戎之地。

translations.literal: Xinjiang: in antiquity the land of the Western Rong beyond the borders of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: Xinjiang: in ancient times this was the territory of the western Rong peoples outside the domain of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 漢武帝設西域都護，天山以南，城郭三十六國皆屬焉。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of Han established the Protectorate of the Western Regions; south of the Tianshan Mountains, all thirty-six walled states belonged to it.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu of Han set up the Protectorate of the Western Regions, every one of the thirty-six walled states south of the Tianshan came under its authority.

sentences.zh: 天山以北，東匈奴右部，西烏孫，未嘗服屬。

translations.literal: North of the Tianshan were the eastern Xiongnu Right Wing in the east and the Wusun in the west; they had never submitted or been subordinated.
translations.idiomatic: North of the Tianshan lay the eastern Xiongnu's Right Wing in the east and the Wusun in the west—peoples that had never acknowledged Chinese overlordship.

sentences.zh: 後漢，山北如故，山南分五十餘國，于闐、龜茲最著。

translations.literal: In Later Han, north of the mountains remained as before; south of the mountains were divided more than fifty states, with Yutian and Kucha most prominent.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Later Han the situation north of the mountains was unchanged, while south of them the region was split among more than fifty states, of which Yutian and Kucha were the most notable.

sentences.zh: 自建武迄延光，三絕三通，設都護及長史治之。

translations.literal: From Jianwu through Yanguang, it was cut off three times and reopened three times; a Protector-General and Chief Clerk were appointed to govern it.
translations.idiomatic: Between the Jianwu and Yanguang reigns contact was severed three times and restored three times; Protectors-General and Chief Clerks were repeatedly installed to administer the region.

sentences.zh: 三國及晉，北為烏孫及鮮卑西部，南為于闐、龜茲諸國。

translations.literal: In the Three Kingdoms and Jin periods, the north was held by the Wusun and the western Xianbei; the south by Yutian, Kucha, and the other states.
translations.idiomatic: During the Three Kingdoms and Jin, the north belonged to the Wusun and the western Xianbei, and the south to Yutian, Kucha, and their neighboring states.

sentences.zh: 北魏，柔然、烏孫、悅般、高車盡有山北地；

translations.literal: Under Northern Wei, the Rouran, Wusun, Yueban, and Gaoche all held the lands north of the mountains;
translations.idiomatic: Under the Northern Wei the Rouran, Wusun, Yueban, and Gaoche each in turn controlled the country north of the mountains;

sentences.zh: 後周，突厥、鐵勒據之。

translations.literal: under Later Zhou, the Turks and Tiele occupied it.
translations.idiomatic: and under the Later Zhou the Turks and Tiele held it.

sentences.zh: 其南以鄯善為強。

translations.literal: To the south Shanshan was strongest.
translations.idiomatic: South of the mountains Shanshan became the dominant power.

sentences.zh: 唐於西州置北庭大都護府，統沙陀、突厥、回鶻、西突厥，北部諸都督府。

translations.literal: The Tang placed the Beiting Protectorate-General at Xizhou, governing the Shatuo, Turks, Uyghurs, Western Turks, and the various northern frontier commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang established the Beiting Protectorate-General at Xizhou to oversee the Shatuo, Turks, Uyghurs, Western Turks, and the northern frontier commanderies.

sentences.zh: 於龜茲置安西大都護府，統龜茲、于闐、疏勒、碎葉四鎮，濛池、昆陵等都護。

translations.literal: At Kucha they placed the Anxi Protectorate-General, governing the four garrisons of Kucha, Yutian, Shule, and Suyab, and the Mengchi and Kunling protectorates.
translations.idiomatic: At Kucha they set up the Anxi Protectorate-General, which controlled the Four Garrisons of Kucha, Yutian, Shule, and Suyab, together with the Mengchi and Kunling protectorates.

sentences.zh: 中葉後，為吐蕃所有。

translations.literal: After the mid-Tang it came into Tibetan possession.
translations.idiomatic: From the mid-Tang onward the region fell under Tibetan control.

sentences.zh: 五代並於吐蕃、回鶻。

translations.literal: In the Five Dynasties it was shared between Tibet and the Uyghurs.
translations.idiomatic: During the Five Dynasties it was divided between Tibet and the Uyghurs.

sentences.zh: 宋時烏孫、回鶻居山北，于闐、龜茲諸國入於遼。

translations.literal: In Song times the Wusun and Uyghurs dwelt north of the mountains; Yutian, Kucha, and the other states entered Liao sway.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song the Wusun and Uyghurs lived north of the mountains, while Yutian, Kucha, and the other states passed under Liao influence.

sentences.zh: 元置三行尚書省，蔥嶺以東屬巴什伯里行尚書省。

translations.literal: The Yuan established three Branch Secretariats; east of the Pamirs belonged to the Bashibali Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan created three Branch Secretariats; the country east of the Pamirs was assigned to the Bashibali Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 尋增天山南、北宣慰司，北則巴什伯里，南則哈喇和卓，後為都哩特穆爾地。

translations.literal: Soon they added Pacification Commissions for south and north of the Tianshan: in the north Bashibali, in the south Khara Khoja—later the land of Dulatmur.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commissions were soon added for the regions south and north of the Tianshan—Bashibali in the north and Khara Khoja in the south—later known as the territory of Dulatmur.

sentences.zh: 明，四衛拉特居北部，曰綽羅斯、曰杜爾伯特、曰和碩特、曰輝特。

translations.literal: In the Ming, four Oirat groups dwelt in the north, called Choros, Derbet, Khoshut, and Khoit.
translations.idiomatic: In the Ming four Oirat confederations occupied the north, known as the Choros, Derbet, Khoshut, and Khoit.

sentences.zh: 其南部則巴什伯里、葉爾羌、吐魯番諸國，回部派噶木巴爾諸族居之。

translations.literal: Its south held the states of Bashibali, Yarkand, and Turfan, where the Hui tribes of the Qaghan Bar clans lived.
translations.idiomatic: The south was held by Bashibali, Yarkand, Turfan, and other states, home to the Qaghan Bar lineages of the Muslim communities.

sentences.zh: 順治四年，哈密內屬，吐魯番亦入貢，惟四衛拉特仍據其地。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shunzhi, Hami submitted; Turfan also sent tribute, but the four Oirat still held their ground.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 4 Hami came within the empire and Turfan began paying tribute, yet the four Oirat confederations still held the northern territories.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾即綽羅斯部。

translations.literal: The Dzungars were the Choros tribe.
translations.idiomatic: The Dzungars were the Choros branch of the Oirat.

sentences.zh: 數侵喀爾喀，聖祖三臨朔漠征之，噶爾丹走死。

translations.literal: They repeatedly raided Khalkha; the Sagely Ancestor thrice campaigned in the northern deserts; Galdan fled and died.
translations.idiomatic: They raided Khalkha again and again until the Kangxi Emperor led three campaigns into the northern steppe; Galdan fled and died in defeat.

sentences.zh: 其兄子策妄阿拉布坦遁伊犁，傳子及孫，從孫達瓦齊奪其位。

translations.literal: His nephew Tsewang Arabtan fled to Ili; the line passed to son and grandson until a collateral descendant Dawachi seized the throne.
translations.idiomatic: His nephew Tsewang Arabtan escaped to Ili and passed rule to his son and grandson until a collateral kinsman, Dawachi, usurped the khanate.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十九年，杜爾伯特、和碩特、輝特先後來歸。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Qianlong, the Derbet, Khoshut, and Khoit submitted in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 19 the Derbet, Khoshut, and Khoit tribes submitted one after another.

sentences.zh: 二十年，執達瓦齊，準噶爾平。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Dawachi was captured and the Dzungars pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 20 Dawachi was taken prisoner and the Dzungar threat was ended.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，以阿睦爾撒納叛，霍集占附之，再出師。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, because Amursana rebelled and Huojishi joined him, troops were sent out again.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 22 Amursana rebelled with Khoja Jahan at his side, and the court launched another campaign.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，克庫車、沙雅爾、阿克蘇、烏什諸城；

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year Kucha, Xayar, Aksu, Ush, and other cities were taken;
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 23 Kucha, Xayar, Aksu, Ush, and other cities fell;

sentences.zh: 明年，收和闐、喀什噶爾、葉爾羌諸城，二酋走死，回部亦平。

translations.literal: the next year Khotan, Kashgar, Yarkand, and other cities were recovered; the two chieftains fled and died, and the Muslim regions were also pacified.
translations.idiomatic: the following year Khotan, Kashgar, Yarkand, and the remaining strongholds were secured; both rebel leaders fled to their deaths, and the Muslim districts were pacified as well.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，設伊犁總統將軍及都統、參贊、辦事、協辦、領隊諸大臣，分駐各城，並設阿奇木伯克理回務。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year the Ili General-in-Chief and various Grand Ministers, Councilors, Affairs Commissioners, Assistant Commissioners, and Brigade Commanders were established, stationed at each city, and Akim begs were appointed to manage Muslim affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 27 an Ili General-in-Chief was appointed together with garrison commanders, councilors, affairs commissioners, assistants, and brigade leaders posted to the major cities, while Akim begs were installed to administer Muslim affairs.

sentences.zh: 秩三品至七品。

translations.literal: Their ranks ran from third to seventh grade.
translations.idiomatic: Their ranks ranged from third to seventh grade.

sentences.zh: 光緒十年裁，改設頭目，以六品為限。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Guangxu they were abolished and headmen were installed instead, capped at sixth grade.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 10 the office was abolished and local headmen were appointed, none above sixth grade.

sentences.zh: 同治三年，安集延酋阿古柏作亂，陝回白彥虎應之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tongzhi the Andijan chief Yaqub Beg rebelled, and the Shaanxi Muslim Bai Yanhu joined him.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 3 the Andijan leader Yaqub Beg rose in revolt, aided by the Shaanxi Muslim Bai Yanhu.

sentences.zh: 光緒八年，全部蕩平。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Guangxu all was swept clean and pacified.
translations.idiomatic: By Guangxu 8 the entire region had been recovered.

sentences.zh: 九年，建行省，置巡撫及布政使司，以分巡鎮迪道兼理按察使銜，改甘肅迪化州及鎮西、哈密、吐魯番三廳來隸。

translations.literal: In the ninth year a provincial administration was established with a Governor and Provincial Administration Commissioner; the Circuit Intendant of Zhendi, also bearing the Acting Surveillance Commissioner title, was appointed; Dihua Prefecture of Gansu and the three subprefectures of Zhenxi, Hami, and Turfan were transferred to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 9 the territory was organized as a province with a governor and provincial administration commissioner; the Zhendi circuit intendant also held the acting surveillance commissioner title; Dihua Prefecture in Gansu and the subprefectures of Zhenxi, Hami, and Turfan were placed under the new province.

sentences.zh: 迪化尋升府，建省治。

translations.literal: Dihua was soon promoted to a prefecture and made the provincial seat.
translations.idiomatic: Dihua was soon elevated to a prefecture and established as the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 又改阿克蘇為溫宿直隸州，喀喇沙爾、庫車、烏什、英吉沙爾並為廳，置分巡阿克蘇道轄之；

translations.literal: Aksu was changed to Wensu Directly Controlled Prefecture; Karashahr, Kucha, Ush, and Yengisar were made subprefectures, and an Aksu Circuit Intendant was placed over them;
translations.idiomatic: Aksu was reorganized as Wensu Direct-Controlled Prefecture, while Karashahr, Kucha, Ush, and Yengisar became subprefectures under a newly created Aksu circuit intendant;

sentences.zh: 喀什噶爾為疏勒、葉爾羌為莎車直隸州，英吉沙爾、瑪喇巴什為廳，及和闐直隸州，置喀喇噶爾兵備道轄之；

translations.literal: Kashgar became Shule and Yarkand became Shache Directly Controlled Prefectures; Yengisar and Maralbeshi became subprefectures, and Khotan a directly controlled prefecture, with a Kashgar Military Defense Circuit placed over them;
translations.idiomatic: Kashgar and Yarkand were made the direct-controlled prefectures of Shule and Shache; Yengisar and Maralbeshi were made subprefectures; Khotan became a direct-controlled prefecture; and a Kashgar military-defense circuit was created to oversee them;

sentences.zh: 庫爾喀喇烏蘇為直隸廳，轄於鎮迪道；

translations.literal: Kur Kara Usu was made a directly controlled subprefecture under the Zhendi Circuit;
translations.idiomatic: Kur Kara Usu was established as a direct-controlled subprefecture under the Zhendi circuit;

sentences.zh: 又改伊犁為府，精河、塔爾巴哈台為廳，置分巡伊塔道轄之。

translations.literal: Ili was changed to a prefecture, Jinghe and Tarbagatai to subprefectures, and an Yita Circuit Intendant was established over them.
translations.idiomatic: Ili was made a prefecture, Jinghe and Tarbagatai subprefectures, and an Yita circuit intendant was appointed to govern them.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，升喀喇沙爾為焉耆府。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year Karashahr was promoted to Yanqi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 24 Karashahr was elevated to Yanqi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，改庫車廳為直隸州，疏勒、莎車、溫宿三直隸州並為府，又改瑪喇巴什廳為巴楚州，隸莎車府。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year Kucha Subprefecture became a directly controlled prefecture; the three directly controlled prefectures of Shule, Shache, and Wensu were all promoted to prefectures; Maralbeshi Subprefecture became Bachu Prefecture, subordinate to Shache Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 28 the Kucha subprefecture was made a direct-controlled prefecture; Shule, Shache, and Wensu were all promoted to full prefectures; Maralbeshi was reorganized as Bachu Prefecture under Shache.

sentences.zh: 凡領府六，直隸廳八，直隸州二，廳一，州一，縣二十一。

translations.literal: In all it governed six prefectures, eight directly controlled subprefectures, two directly controlled prefectures, one subprefecture, one prefecture, and twenty-one counties.
translations.idiomatic: The province altogether comprised six prefectures, eight direct-controlled subprefectures, two direct-controlled prefectures, one subprefecture, one department, and twenty-one counties.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，編戶四十五萬三千四百七十七，口二百六萬九千一百六十五。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuantong registered households numbered 453,477 and population 2,069,165.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 3 there were 453,477 registered households and a population of 2,069,165.

sentences.zh: 東界外蒙古喀爾喀扎薩克圖汗部；

translations.literal: On the east it bordered the Khalkha Zasaghtu Khan Banner of Outer Mongolia;
translations.idiomatic: To the east it bordered the Khalkha Zasaghtu Khan banner of Outer Mongolia;

sentences.zh: 西界俄羅斯；

translations.literal: On the west it borders Russia;
translations.idiomatic: On the west it borders Russia;

sentences.zh: 南界西藏；

translations.literal: On the south it borders Tibet;
translations.idiomatic: On the south it borders Tibet;

sentences.zh: 北界阿爾泰山；

translations.literal: On the north it borders the Altai Mountains;
translations.idiomatic: On the north it borders the Altai Mountains;

sentences.zh: 東南界甘肅、青海；

translations.literal: On the southeast it borders Gansu and Qinghai;
translations.idiomatic: On the southeast it borders Gansu and Qinghai;

sentences.zh: 西南界帕米爾；

translations.literal: On the southwest it borders the Pamirs;
translations.idiomatic: On the southwest it borders the Pamirs;

sentences.zh: 東北界科布多；

translations.literal: On the northeast it borders Kobdo;
translations.idiomatic: On the northeast it borders Kobdo;

sentences.zh: 西北界俄羅斯。

translations.literal: on the northwest Russia.
translations.idiomatic: and to the northwest Russia again.

sentences.zh: 廣七千四百里，袤三千七百里。

translations.literal: It measures 7,400 li in breadth and 3,700 li in length.
translations.idiomatic: It spans 7,400 li from east to west and 3,700 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 東北距京師，由南路八千六百八十九里，由北路八千五百七十六里。

translations.literal: From the northeast to the capital is 8,689 li by the southern route and 8,576 li by the northern route.
translations.idiomatic: From its northeastern corner to the capital is 8,689 li by the southern road and 8,576 li by the northern road.

sentences.zh: 北極高三十四度至四十九度有奇。

translations.literal: Northern latitude runs from 34 degrees to somewhat more than 49 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Its northern latitude ranges from 34° to just over 49°.

sentences.zh: 京師偏西二十一度至四十三度。

translations.literal: West of the capital it lies between 21 and 43 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 21° to 43° west of Beijing.

sentences.zh: 其名山：蔥嶺、崑崙、天山、博克達。

translations.literal: Its famous mountains: the Pamirs, Kunlun, Tianshan, and Bogda.
translations.idiomatic: Notable mountains include the Pamirs, Kunlun, Tianshan, and Bogda.

sentences.zh: 其巨川：塔里木、葉爾羌、和闐、伊犁諸河。

translations.literal: Its great rivers: the Tarim, Yarkand, Khotan, Ili, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Major rivers include the Tarim, Yarkand, Khotan, Ili, and their tributaries.

sentences.zh: 其道路：天山南、北。

translations.literal: Its roads: south and north of the Tianshan.
translations.idiomatic: Roads run along both the southern and northern slopes of the Tianshan.

sentences.zh: 電線：由迪化東南通蘭州，西北通伊犁，西南通喀什噶爾。

translations.literal: Telegraph lines: from Dihua southeast to Lanzhou, northwest to Ili, southwest to Kashgar.
translations.idiomatic: Telegraph lines run from Dihua southeast to Lanzhou, northwest to Ili, and southwest to Kashgar.

sentences.zh: 迪化府：，沖，繁，難。

translations.literal: Dihua Prefecture: , critical, busy, difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Dihua Prefecture: critical, busy, and difficult.

sentences.zh: 巡撫、布政使、提學使、鎮迪道兼提法司銜、副將同駐。

translations.literal: The Governor, Provincial Administration Commissioner, Education Commissioner, Zhendi Circuit Intendant with Acting Surveillance Commissioner title, and Vice General are all stationed here.
translations.idiomatic: The governor, provincial administration commissioner, education commissioner, Zhendi circuit intendant with acting surveillance commissioner title, and vice general are all headquartered here.

sentences.zh: 漢，卑陸等十三國地，兼有匈奴屬地及烏孫東境。

translations.literal: In Han times it was the land of the thirteen states including Beilu, together with dependent Xiongnu territory and the eastern border of the Wusun.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Han it comprised the territories of the thirteen states including Beilu, together with dependent Xiongnu lands and the eastern marches of the Wusun.

sentences.zh: 後漢初，郁立師、單桓、烏貪訾離為車師所滅，後復立，時稱車師六國。

translations.literal: Early in Later Han, Yulishi, Danhuan, and Wuganzhi were destroyed by the Cheshi; later restored, they were called the Six States of Cheshi.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Later Han the states of Yulishi, Danhuan, and Wuganzhi were destroyed by Cheshi but later restored, and the group came to be known as the Six States of Cheshi.

sentences.zh: 三國時，東西且彌、單桓、卑陸、蒲類、烏貪，並屬車師後部。

translations.literal: In the Three Kingdoms period Eastern and Western Qiemi, Danhuan, Beilu, Pulei, and Wugan all belonged to the Rear Kingdom of Cheshi.
translations.idiomatic: During the Three Kingdoms period Eastern and Western Qiemi, Danhuan, Beilu, Pulei, and Wugan were all subject to the Rear Kingdom of Cheshi.

sentences.zh: 晉屬鐵勒，亦曰高車。

translations.literal: Under Jin it belonged to the Tiele, also called the Gaoche.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Jin it fell to the Tiele, also known as the Gaoche.

sentences.zh: 初屬蠕蠕。

translations.literal: At first it belonged to the Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: It was initially subject to the Rouran.

sentences.zh: 北魏時，大破蠕蠕。

translations.literal: Under Northern Wei they inflicted a great defeat on the Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Northern Wei they shattered the Rouran.

sentences.zh: 後周屬突厥。

translations.literal: Under Later Zhou it belonged to the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Later Zhou it passed to the Turks.

sentences.zh: 隋大業中，西突厥始大，鐵勒諸部皆臣之。

translations.literal: In the Daye era of Sui the Western Turks first grew powerful and all the Tiele tribes submitted.
translations.idiomatic: During the Sui emperor Yang's Daye reign the Western Turks rose to dominance and the Tiele tribes all submitted to them.

sentences.zh: 唐貞觀時內屬。

translations.literal: In the Zhenguan era of Tang it submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the Tang Zhenguan era it came within the empire.

sentences.zh: 及滅高昌，置庭州。

translations.literal: When Gaochang was destroyed, Ting Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: After Gaochang was destroyed Ting Prefecture was established here.

sentences.zh: 又置瑤池都督府及馮洛州各都督府，統於安西大都護府。

translations.literal: The Yaozhi Area Command and the various area commands of Fengluo Prefecture were also established, subordinate to the Anxi Protectorate-General.
translations.idiomatic: The Yaozhi area command and the area commands of Fengluo Prefecture were also set up, all under the Anxi Protectorate-General.

sentences.zh: 武后時，改隸北庭大都護府。

translations.literal: Under Empress Wu it was transferred to the Beiting Protectorate-General.
translations.idiomatic: Under Empress Wu it was reassigned to the Beiting Protectorate-General.

sentences.zh: 開元初，置北庭節度使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaiyuan the Beiting Military Commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Kaiyuan reign a Beiting military commissioner was appointed.

sentences.zh: 貞元後，其地屬吐蕃，又屬西州回鶻。

translations.literal: After Zhenyuan its land belonged to Tibet, then to the Xizhou Uyghurs.
translations.idiomatic: After the Zhenyuan era the region fell to Tibet and later to the Xizhou Uyghurs.

sentences.zh: 宋為高昌北庭，臣服於遼。

translations.literal: In Song it was Gaochang and Beiting, subject to the Liao.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song it formed Gaochang and Beiting, both acknowledging Liao overlordship.

sentences.zh: 南宋屬西遼。

translations.literal: Under Southern Song it belonged to Western Liao.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Southern Song it passed to the Western Liao.

sentences.zh: 元太祖時，稱回鶻別失八里。

translations.literal: Under Yuan Taizu it was called Uyghur Beshbalik.
translations.idiomatic: Under Genghis Khan it was known as Uyghur Beshbalik.

sentences.zh: 元末，猛可鐵木兒據之，為瓦剌國。

translations.literal: At the end of Yuan, Mengke Temür seized it and made the Oirat state.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Yuan Mengke Temür seized the region and founded the Oirat khanate.

sentences.zh: 至明正統中為乜先。

translations.literal: By the Zhengtong reign of Ming it was held by Esen.
translations.idiomatic: By the Ming Zhengtong reign it was ruled by Esen.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖間，分為四衛拉特，為瓦剌之轉音。

translations.literal: In the Jiajing era it split into four Oirat, a transcription of Oirat.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jiajing period it divided into the Four Oirat confederations—the name being a transcription of Oirat.

sentences.zh: 居烏魯木齊者為和碩特部。

translations.literal: Those dwelling at Urumqi were the Khoshut tribe.
translations.idiomatic: The Khoshut branch occupied Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 後為準噶爾台吉游牧地。

translations.literal: Later it became the nomadic pasture of the Dzungar taiji.
translations.idiomatic: Later it became pasturage for the Dzungar taiji.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十年，平準噶爾，始內屬，改名烏魯木齊，築土城。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Qianlong the Dzungars were pacified; it first submitted, was renamed Urumqi, and an earthen wall city was built.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 20, after the Dzungars were defeated, the area submitted; it was renamed Urumqi and an earthen-walled town was built.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，設同知。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year a Subprefect was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 25 a subprefect was appointed.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，築新城於其北，名迪化。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year a new city was built to its north, named Dihua.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 28 a new city was built to the north and named Dihua.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，設參贊大臣、理事、通判。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year a Councilor Minister, Affairs Commissioner, and Prefectural Judge were established.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 36 a councilor minister, affairs commissioner, and prefectural judge were installed.

sentences.zh: 明年，於迪化西八里築滿城，名曰鞏寧。

translations.literal: The next year, eight li west of Dihua a Manchu garrison city was built, named Gongning.
translations.idiomatic: The following year a Manchu garrison city called Gongning was built eight li west of Dihua.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，改參贊為都統，設領隊大臣，駐鞏寧。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year the Councilor was changed to a Commandant, and a Brigade Commander was established, stationed at Gongning.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 38 the councilor post became a commandant and a brigade commander was posted to Gongning.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，升直隸州，隸甘肅布政司。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year it was promoted to a directly controlled prefecture under the Gansu Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Also in Qianlong 38 it was promoted to a direct-controlled prefecture under the Gansu provincial administration.

sentences.zh: 光緒九年，建行省，十二年，升府來隸。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Guangxu the province was established; in the twelfth year it was promoted to a prefecture and placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 9 the provincial government was created; in Guangxu 12 Dihua was elevated to a prefecture under the new province.

sentences.zh: 廣一千四百里，袤五百二十里。

translations.literal: It measures 1,400 li in breadth and 520 li in length.
translations.idiomatic: It measures 1,400 li from east to west and 520 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 北極高四十三度二十七分。

translations.literal: Northern latitude is 43 degrees 27 minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Its northern latitude is 43°27′.

sentences.zh: 京師偏西二十七度五十六分。

translations.literal: West of the capital it lies 27 degrees 56 minutes.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 27°56′ west of Beijing.

sentences.zh: 領縣六。

translations.literal: It governs six counties.
translations.idiomatic: It administers six counties.

sentences.zh: 光緒七年與俄立約，定為商埠。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Guangxu a treaty was made with Russia designating it a treaty port.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 7 a treaty with Russia designated it a treaty port.

sentences.zh: 迪化沖，繁，難。

translations.literal: Dihua: critical, busy, difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Dihua County: critical, busy, difficult.

sentences.zh: 倚。

translations.literal: Attached to the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Attached to the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 光緒十二年置。

translations.literal: Established in the twelfth year of Guangxu.
translations.idiomatic: It was established in Guangxu 12.

sentences.zh: 天山自西來，橫亙境南。

translations.literal: The Tianshan comes from the west and extends horizontally across the southern border of the jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Tianshan enters from the west and runs east-west across the county's southern marches.

sentences.zh: 西南：雅馬拉克山，綿延二百里。

translations.literal: Southwest: Yamalak Mountain, extending two hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest lies Yamalak Mountain, stretching two hundred li.

sentences.zh: 東北：達坂城嶺。

translations.literal: Northeast: Dabancheng Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Dabancheng Ridge.

sentences.zh: 東南：哈拉巴爾噶遜山。

translations.literal: Southeast: Halaba'ergaxun Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Halaba'ergaxun Mountain.

sentences.zh: 烏魯木齊河出南山，二源：東南曰庫爾齊勒河，西曰阿拉塔濟河，合北流，經城西，又北，名老龍河。

translations.literal: The Urumqi River emerges from the southern mountains; it has two sources: to the southeast called the Kurqile River, to the west called the Alataji River; joining, they flow north, pass west of the city, then turn north again, and are called the Old Dragon River.
translations.idiomatic: The Urumqi River rises in the southern mountains from two headwaters—the Kurqile River in the southeast and the Alataji River in the west. After they merge the stream flows north past the west side of the city, then continues north under the name Old Dragon River.

sentences.zh: 頭屯河自昌吉入，東北流入境，瀦為八段、馬廠二湖，溢出，北流，與西支合，為兩縣交界處，三屯河自昌吉北來注之。

translations.literal: The Toutun River enters from Changji, flows into the jurisdiction from the northeast, pools into the two lakes of Baduan and Machang, overflows, flows north, joins the western branch, forming the boundary between the two counties; the Santun River comes from the north of Changji and joins it.
translations.idiomatic: The Toutun River enters from Changji and flows northeast into the county, forming the Baduan and Machang lakes before spilling north to meet a western branch at the boundary between the two counties, where the Santun River descending from north of Changji joins it.

sentences.zh: 復東北流，合老龍河，北經沙漠，入古爾班托羅海。

translations.literal: It again flows northeast, joins the Old Dragon River, passes north through desert, and enters the Gurbantüngüt Sea.
translations.idiomatic: Continuing northeast, it merges with the Old Dragon River, crosses the desert northward, and empties into the Gurbantüngüt Sea.

sentences.zh: 廟兒溝、羊圈溝、大東溝、小東溝諸水，均出縣東南，分流，南入吐魯番。

translations.literal: The waters of Miao'ergou, Yangjuangou, Dadonggou, and Xiaodonggou all emerge from the county's southeast, divide into branches, and enter Turpan to the south.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao'ergou, Yangjuangou, Dadonggou, and Xiaodonggou streams all rise in the county's southeast, divide into branches, and flow south into Turpan.

sentences.zh: 達坂城水，源出阜康博克達山天馬峰，入縣境，南流，合大銅溝、華樹林、方家溝、白家溝諸水，經達坂城卡倫入吐魯番。

translations.literal: The Dabancheng water, sourced from Tianma Peak of Bokda Mountain in Fukang, enters the county jurisdiction, flows south, joins the waters of Datonggou, Huashulin, Fangjiagou, and Baijiagou, passes through the Dabancheng barrier post, and enters Turpan.
translations.idiomatic: The Dabancheng stream rises at Tianma Peak on Fukang's Bokda Mountain, enters the county flowing south, absorbs the Datonggou, Huashulin, Fangjiagou, and Baijiagou waters, and passes through the Dabancheng barrier post into Turpan.

sentences.zh: 東南：鄂門泊、達布遜泊。

translations.literal: Southeast: E'men Lake and Dabuxun Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast are E'men Lake and Dabuxun Lake.

sentences.zh: 北：大戈璧，廣五百里，長三百里。

translations.literal: North: the Great Gobi, five hundred li in breadth and three hundred li in length.
translations.idiomatic: To the north lies the Great Gobi, measuring five hundred li across and three hundred li long.

sentences.zh: 卡倫七。

translations.literal: Seven barrier posts.
translations.idiomatic: There are seven barrier posts.

sentences.zh: 台八。

translations.literal: Eight courier stations.
translations.idiomatic: There are eight courier stations.

sentences.zh: 驛四：鞏寧、柴俄堡、達坂城、黑溝。

translations.literal: Four post stations: Gongning, Chai'ebao, Dabancheng, and Heigou.
translations.idiomatic: Post stations number four: Gongning, Chai'ebao, Dabancheng, and Heigou.

sentences.zh: 有回庄六十七。

translations.literal: There are sixty-seven Muslim villages.
translations.idiomatic: The county has sixty-seven Muslim villages.

sentences.zh: 阜康沖，繁，難。

translations.literal: Fukang: critical, busy, difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Fukang County: critical, busy, difficult.

sentences.zh: 府東北一百三十里。

translations.literal: One hundred thirty li northeast of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 130 li northeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 漢，郁立師、車師後國。

translations.literal: Han: Yulishi and the Rear Kingdom of Cheshi.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Han it was Yulishi and the Rear Kingdom of Cheshi.

sentences.zh: 魏，蠕蠕地。

translations.literal: Wei: Rouran territory.
translations.idiomatic: Under Wei it was Rouran territory.

sentences.zh: 周、隋，突厥。

translations.literal: Zhou and Sui: Turks.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Zhou and Sui it belonged to the Turks.

sentences.zh: 唐，浮圖、沙缽、憑洛、耶勒、俱六諸地，貞觀中置金滿縣。

translations.literal: Tang: the lands of Futuo, Shabo, Pingluo, Yele, and Juliu; in the Zhenguan era Jinman County was established.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang the area comprised Futuo, Shabo, Pingluo, Yele, and Juliu; Jinman County was created in the Zhenguan period.

sentences.zh: 元，別失八里地。

translations.literal: Yuan: Beshbalik territory.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Beshbalik territory.

sentences.zh: 明，敦剌城，改名特訥格爾。

translations.literal: Ming: Dunla City, renamed Tenege'er.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it was Dunla City, later renamed Tenege'er.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十五年築堡，置巡司，尋改縣丞。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Qianlong a fort was built and a patrol commissioner was established; soon changed to an assistant magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 25 a fort was built and a patrol commissioner appointed, soon replaced by an assistant magistrate.

sentences.zh: 二十八年建城，改州判，隸安西道。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year a city was built, changed to a prefectural judge, subordinate to the Anxi Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 28 a walled city was built, the post became a prefectural judge, and the county was placed under the Anxi Circuit.

sentences.zh: 三十八年併入迪化州境。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year it was merged into Dihua Prefecture's territory.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 38 it was annexed to Dihua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 四十一年裁州判，置縣。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year the prefectural judge was abolished and a county was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 41 the prefectural judge was abolished and a county established.

sentences.zh: 博克達山綿亙南境，最高者曰福壽山。

translations.literal: Bokda Mountain extends across the southern border; the highest peak is called Fushou Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Bokda Mountain runs across the county's southern marches; its highest peak is Fushou Mountain.

sentences.zh: 迤北，小黃山、大黃山。

translations.literal: Winding north are Little Huangshan and Great Huangshan.
translations.idiomatic: Continuing north are Little Huangshan and Great Huangshan.

sentences.zh: 縣境諸水均發源博克達山。

translations.literal: All waters within the county jurisdiction take their source from Bokda Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Every stream in the county rises on Bokda Mountain.

sentences.zh: 西：水磨河，西北流，分大西溝、小西溝二水。

translations.literal: West: the Shuimo River, flowing northwest, divides into the two waters of Daxigou and Xiaoxigou.
translations.idiomatic: To the west the Shuimo River flows northwest and splits into the Daxigou and Xiaoxigou streams.

sentences.zh: 東有三工河，北流，疏為五渠。

translations.literal: To the east is the Sangong River, flowing north, divided into five canals.
translations.idiomatic: East of it the Sangong River flows north and is divided into five irrigation canals.

sentences.zh: 又東有四工河，北流，疏為四渠。

translations.literal: Further east is the Sigong River, flowing north, divided into four canals.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east the Sigong River flows north and is split into four canals.

sentences.zh: 又東為土墩子河，北流，疏為六渠。

translations.literal: Further east is the Tudunzi River, flowing north, divided into six canals.
translations.idiomatic: Still farther east the Tudunzi River flows north and is divided into six canals.

sentences.zh: 又東有柏楊河，北流，疏為四渠。

translations.literal: Further east is the Baiyang River, flowing north, divided into four canals.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east still, the Baiyang River flows north and is split into four canals.

sentences.zh: 又東曰東溝、西溝，北流入沙漠，合流而北，復分為東、中、西三渠。

translations.literal: Further east are called Donggou and Xigou; flowing north into the desert, they join and flow north, then again divide into eastern, central, and western three canals.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east are Donggou and Xigou, which flow north into the desert, merge, continue north, and then divide again into eastern, central, and western canals.

sentences.zh: 卡倫四。

translations.literal: Four barrier posts.
translations.idiomatic: There are four barrier posts.

sentences.zh: 台四。

translations.literal: Four courier stations.
translations.idiomatic: There are four courier stations.

sentences.zh: 驛三：在城、康樂、柏楊。

translations.literal: Three post stations: Zaicheng, Kangle, and Baiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Post stations number three: Zaicheng, Kangle, and Baiyang.

sentences.zh: 縣境分區二十七。

translations.literal: The county jurisdiction is divided into twenty-seven districts.
translations.idiomatic: The county is divided into twenty-seven districts.

sentences.zh: 孚遠沖，繁，難。

translations.literal: Fuyuan: critical, busy, difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Fuyuan County: critical, busy, difficult.

sentences.zh: 府東北三百六十里。

translations.literal: Three hundred sixty li northeast of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 360 li northeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 兩漢，車師後國，及其後城長國。

translations.literal: Both Han dynasties: the Rear Kingdom of Cheshi and its Chief-of-the-Rear-City Kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Under both Han dynasties it was the Rear Kingdom of Cheshi and its Chief-of-the-Rear-City Kingdom.

sentences.zh: 魏，蠕蠕。

translations.literal: Wei: Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: Under Wei it was Rouran territory.

sentences.zh: 周，突厥。

translations.literal: Zhou: Turks.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Zhou it belonged to the Turks.

sentences.zh: 唐，金滿縣。

translations.literal: Tang: Jinman County.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it was Jinman County.

sentences.zh: 元，北庭都元帥府舊治，乾隆三十七年築愷安城，四十一年設濟木薩縣丞，治愷安，屬阜康。

translations.literal: Yuan: former seat of the Beiting Military Governorate; in the thirty-seventh year of Qianlong Kai'an City was built; in the forty-first year a Jimusa assistant magistrate was established, administering from Kai'an, subordinate to Fukang.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was the former seat of the Beiting Military Governorate; in Qianlong 37 Kai'an City was built, and in Qianlong 41 a Jimusa assistant magistrate was posted to Kai'an under Fukang.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十年重修城，改名孚遠，二十九年升置。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Guangxu the city was rebuilt and renamed Fuyuan; in the twenty-ninth year it was promoted and established.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 20 the city was rebuilt and renamed Fuyuan; in Guangxu 29 it was elevated to county status.

sentences.zh: 博克達山支脈蜿蜒起伏入境。

translations.literal: A spur of Bokda Mountain winds in and out entering the jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: A spur of Bokda Mountain winds in and out of the county border.

sentences.zh: 西南：無量山。

translations.literal: Southwest: Wuliang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Wuliang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 東南冰山、迤北千佛洞，皆博克達山之麓。

translations.literal: Southeast: Ice Mountain; winding north, the Thousand Buddha Caves—all at the foot of Bokda Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Ice Mountain lies to the southeast, and the Thousand Buddha Caves farther north—both at the foot of Bokda Mountain.

sentences.zh: 城南小水均發源冰山。

translations.literal: Small waters south of the city all take their source from Ice Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The minor streams south of the city all rise on Ice Mountain.

sentences.zh: 曰太平、公盛二渠，由柏楊河分支。

translations.literal: Called the Taiping and Gongsheng two canals, branching from the Baiyang River.
translations.idiomatic: The Taiping and Gongsheng canals branch from the Baiyang River.

sentences.zh: 曰長山、三盛二渠，出四道橋北。

translations.literal: Called the Changshan and Sansheng two canals, emerging north of Sidao Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: The Changshan and Sansheng canals issue north of Sidao Bridge.

sentences.zh: 曰濟木薩河，分大有、興隆二渠。

translations.literal: Called the Jimusa River, dividing into the Dayou and Xinglong two canals.
translations.idiomatic: The Jimusa River splits into the Dayou and Xinglong canals.

sentences.zh: 曰長勝渠。

translations.literal: Called the Changsheng Canal.
translations.idiomatic: There is the Changsheng Canal.

sentences.zh: 曰大東溝，北流入慶陽湖。

translations.literal: Called Dadonggou, flowing north into Qingyang Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Dadonggou flows north into Qingyang Lake.

sentences.zh: 曰經二工河，北流，經老三台驛，瀦為麻菰湖。

translations.literal: Called the Jing'ergong River, flowing north, passing the Old Santai post station, pooling into Magu Lake.
translations.idiomatic: The Jing'ergong River flows north past the Old Santai post station and pools into Magu Lake.

sentences.zh: 泉水三：東、西曰大泉，中曰上暖泉，均北流入沙磧。

translations.literal: Three springs: east and west called Daquan, center called Shangnuanquan; all flow north into sandy desert.
translations.idiomatic: Three springs—the eastern and western called Daquan and the central called Shangnuanquan—all flow north into the sandy desert.

sentences.zh: 驛二：保會、三台。

translations.literal: Two post stations: Baohui and Santai.
translations.idiomatic: Post stations number two: Baohui and Santai.

sentences.zh: 卡倫二。

translations.literal: Two barrier posts.
translations.idiomatic: There are two barrier posts.

sentences.zh: 有回庄二十五。

translations.literal: There are twenty-five Muslim villages.
translations.idiomatic: The county has twenty-five Muslim villages.

sentences.zh: 奇台沖，繁，難。

translations.literal: Qitai: critical, busy, difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Qitai County: critical, busy, difficult.

sentences.zh: 府東北五百五十里。

translations.literal: Five hundred fifty li northeast of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 550 li northeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 漢，蒲類、車師後城長國。

translations.literal: Han: Pulei and the Chief-of-the-Rear-City Kingdom of Cheshi.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Han it was Pulei and the Chief-of-the-Rear-City Kingdom of Cheshi.

sentences.zh: 魏屬蠕蠕。

translations.literal: Under Wei it belonged to the Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: Under Wei it was subject to the Rouran.

sentences.zh: 唐，蒲類，後置甘露州。

translations.literal: Tang: Pulei; later Ganlu Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it was Pulei; Ganlu Prefecture was later established there.

sentences.zh: 同光初入遼。

translations.literal: In the Tongguang era it first came under the Liao.
translations.idiomatic: In the Tongguang era it first passed to the Liao.

sentences.zh: 宋南渡後為別失八里東境。

translations.literal: After the Song moved south, it became the eastern border of Beshbalik.
translations.idiomatic: After the Song court moved south it became the eastern marches of Beshbalik.

sentences.zh: 元入畏吾兒。

translations.literal: Under Yuan it entered the Uyghurs.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it passed to the Uyghurs.

sentences.zh: 明，衛拉特地。

translations.literal: Ming: Oirat territory.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it was Oirat territory.

sentences.zh: 康熙中，準噶爾內附，乾隆二十四年建奇台堡，設管糧通判一。

translations.literal: In the Kangxi era the Dzungars submitted; in the twenty-fourth year of Qianlong Qitai Fort was built and one grain-administration prefectural judge was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kangxi period the Dzungars submitted; in Qianlong 24 Qitai Fort was built and a grain-administration prefectural judge was appointed.

sentences.zh: 東吉爾瑪泰，管糧巡檢一。

translations.literal: At Dongji'ermatai, one grain-administration patrol inspector.
translations.idiomatic: At Dongji'ermatai there was one grain-administration patrol inspector.

sentences.zh: 四十年築靖遠城。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year Jingyuan City was built.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 40 Jingyuan City was built.

sentences.zh: 四十一年裁通判，置縣，隸鎮西。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year the prefectural judge was abolished and a county was established, subordinate to Zhenxi.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 41 the prefectural judge was abolished, a county was established, and it was placed under Zhenxi.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年改隸迪化州。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng it was changed to be subordinate to Dihua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 3 it was transferred to Dihua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 光緒十五年自靖遠徙今治。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Guangxu the seat was moved from Jingyuan to the present location.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 15 the county seat was moved from Jingyuan to its present location.

sentences.zh: 天山支脈自西南更格爾入境，至穆家地溝東出境，綿亙四五百里，土人謂之南山。

translations.literal: A spur of the Tianshan enters the jurisdiction from Gengge'er in the southwest, exits east of Mujiadigou, extending four or five hundred li; locals call it the Southern Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: A Tianshan spur enters from Gengge'er in the southwest and leaves east of Mujiadigou, running four or five hundred li; local people call it the Southern Mountains.

sentences.zh: 沙山自濟木薩至縣境舊城北，迄鎮西廳，袤延三四百里。

translations.literal: Sand mountains from Jimusa to north of the county's old city, reaching to Zhenxi Subprefecture, extending three or four hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: Sand hills run from Jimusa to north of the old county seat and on to Zhenxi Subprefecture, stretching three or four hundred li.

sentences.zh: 北：拜達克山。

translations.literal: North: Baidake Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Baidake Mountain.

sentences.zh: 東北：哈布塔克山。

translations.literal: Northeast: Habutake Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Habutake Mountain.

sentences.zh: 縣境諸水皆自南山出，曰奇台水、木壘河、木楊河、新戶梁水、中葛根水、西葛根水、永豐渠水、吉爾庫水、達坂河、更格爾水。

translations.literal: All waters within the county jurisdiction emerge from the Southern Mountains, namely the Qitai water, Mulei River, Muyang River, Xinhuiliang water, Middle Gegen water, Western Gegen water, Yongfeng Canal water, Ji'erku water, Daba River, and Gengge'er water.
translations.idiomatic: Every stream in the county rises in the Southern Mountains: the Qitai stream, Mulei River, Muyang River, Xinhuiliang stream, Middle Gegen stream, Western Gegen stream, Yongfeng Canal, Ji'erku stream, Daba River, and Gengge'er stream.

sentences.zh: 柳樹河自孚遠東流入境，經縣北，又東至三個莊子，入沙磧。

translations.literal: The Liushu River enters the jurisdiction from east of Fuyuan, passes north of the county, then east to Sangezhuangzi, and enters sandy desert.
translations.idiomatic: The Liushu River enters from east of Fuyuan, runs along the north of the county, continues east to Sangezhuangzi, and sinks into the sandy desert.

sentences.zh: 驛十：古城子、平營、木壘河、阿克他斯、烏蘭烏蘇、色必口、頭水溝、北道橋、黃草湖、元湖。

translations.literal: Ten post stations: Guchengzi, Pingying, Mulei River, Aketasi, Wulanwusu, Sebikou, Toushuigou, Beidao Bridge, Huangcaohu, and Yuanhu.
translations.idiomatic: Post stations number ten: Guchengzi, Pingying, Mulei River, Aketasi, Wulanwusu, Sebikou, Toushuigou, Beidao Bridge, Huangcaohu, and Yuanhu.

sentences.zh: 縣境分區三十六。

translations.literal: The county jurisdiction is divided into thirty-six districts.
translations.idiomatic: The county is divided into thirty-six districts.

sentences.zh: 卡倫十六。

translations.literal: Sixteen barrier posts.
translations.idiomatic: There are sixteen barrier posts.

sentences.zh: 台七。

translations.literal: Seven courier stations.
translations.idiomatic: There are seven courier stations.

sentences.zh: 舊城，巡司駐。

translations.literal: Old city: patrol commissioner stationed.
translations.idiomatic: At the old city a patrol commissioner is stationed.

sentences.zh: 光緒七年，俄約定古城為商埠。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Guangxu, by treaty with Russia Gucheng was designated a treaty port.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 7 a treaty with Russia designated Gucheng a treaty port.

sentences.zh: 昌吉沖，繁。

translations.literal: Changji: critical, busy.
translations.idiomatic: Changji County: critical, busy.

sentences.zh: 府西九十里。

translations.literal: Ninety li west of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 90 li west of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 漢，單桓、東西且彌、烏貪訾離地。

translations.literal: Han: Danhuan, Eastern and Western Qiemi, and Wuganzhi lands.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Han it comprised Danhuan, Eastern and Western Qiemi, and Wuganzhi.

sentences.zh: 晉屬高車。

translations.literal: Under Jin it belonged to the Gaoche.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Jin it fell to the Gaoche.

sentences.zh: 魏，蠕蠕。

translations.literal: Wei: Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: Under Wei it was Rouran territory.

sentences.zh: 隋，西突厥、鐵勒地。

translations.literal: Sui: Western Turks and Tiele territory.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Sui it was Western Turk and Tiele territory.

sentences.zh: 唐屬北庭。

translations.literal: Under Tang it belonged to Beiting.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it was part of Beiting.

sentences.zh: 元屬回鶻五城，名昌都剌。

translations.literal: Under Yuan it belonged to the five cities of the Uyghurs, named Changdula.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it belonged to the Uyghur five cities and was called Changdula.

sentences.zh: 明屬衛拉特。

translations.literal: Under Ming it belonged to the Oirat.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it was Oirat territory.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十五年置廳，設通判。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Qianlong a subprefecture was established and a prefectural judge was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 25 a subprefecture was created and a prefectural judge appointed.

sentences.zh: 二十七年築寧邊城，設管糧巡檢。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year Ningbian City was built and a grain-administration patrol inspector was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 27 Ningbian City was built and a grain-administration patrol inspector was appointed.

sentences.zh: 三十八年改州同。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year it was changed to a subprefect.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 38 the post was changed to a subprefect.

sentences.zh: 四十二年置縣。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year a county was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 42 a county was established.

sentences.zh: 天山支脈，綿亙縣境。

translations.literal: A spur of the Tianshan extends continuously through the county jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: A Tianshan spur runs continuously across the county.

sentences.zh: 南：騷呼達坂、格柵圖山、草達坂、石梯子山、塔拉盤山。

translations.literal: South: Saohu Daban, Gegatu Mountain, Caodaban, Shitizi Mountain, and Talapan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the south are Saohu Pass, Gegatu Mountain, Caodaban, Shitizi Mountain, and Talapan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 頭屯河出天山北麓，分東西二支：東支入迪化；

translations.literal: The Toutun River emerges from the northern foothills of the Tianshan and divides into eastern and western branches: the eastern branch enters Dihua;
translations.idiomatic: The Toutun River rises on the northern Tianshan foothills and splits into eastern and western branches; the eastern branch flows into Dihua;

sentences.zh: 西支經縣治東，復北流，至縣境合流入迪化。

translations.literal: The western branch passes east of the county seat, turns north again, and at the county border joins the other branch and enters Dihua.
translations.idiomatic: The western branch passes east of the county seat, turns north again, reunites at the county border, and enters Dihua.

sentences.zh: 大西河亦出天山北麓，至縣治西，分二支：東為三屯河，東北流，注頭屯河；

translations.literal: The Great Western River also emerges from the northern foothills of the Tianshan; reaching west of the county seat, it divides into two branches: the eastern is the Santun River, flowing northeast and emptying into the Toutun River;
translations.idiomatic: The Great Western River also rises on the northern Tianshan foothills; west of the county seat it splits in two: the eastern branch is the Santun River, which flows northeast into the Toutun River;

sentences.zh: 西為大西河，即洛克倫河，自焉耆東北流入境，折西北流，經呼圖壁，緣綏來界。

translations.literal: The western is the Great Western River, that is the Luokelun River, entering the jurisdiction from the northeast of Yanqi, turning northwest, passing Huitubi, and running along the Suilai border.
translations.idiomatic: The western branch is the Great Western River, also called the Luokelun River, which enters from northeast of Yanqi, turns northwest, passes Huitubi, and runs along the Suilai boundary.

sentences.zh: 呼圖壁河源出塔拉盤山西，自焉耆府北流入，棗溝水南來注之。

translations.literal: The Huitubi River source emerges west of Talapan Mountain, enters from north of Yanqi Prefecture, and the Zaogou water joins it from the south.
translations.idiomatic: The Huitubi River rises west of Talapan Mountain, enters from north of Yanqi Prefecture, and is joined from the south by the Zaogou stream.

sentences.zh: 又北經草達坂，東分頭工渠，西分土古里渠，又北至呼圖壁城。

translations.literal: Continuing north through Caodaban, it divides east into the Tougong Canal and west into the Tuguli Canal, then reaches Huitubi City.
translations.idiomatic: Farther north it passes Caodaban, splits east into the Tougong Canal and west into the Tuguli Canal, and reaches Huitubi City.

sentences.zh: 復分二渠，東曰梁渠，西曰西河，北經牛圈子、三家梁，至雙岔子，合洛克倫河，西北入綏來，瀦於阿雅爾淖爾。

translations.literal: It again divides into two canals: the eastern called Liang Canal and the western called West River; flowing north through Niujuanzi and Sanjialiang to Shuangchazi, it joins the Luokelun River, enters Suilai to the northwest, and pools in Ayar Lake.
translations.idiomatic: It divides again into the Liang Canal on the east and the West River on the west; flowing north through Niujuanzi and Sanjialiang to Shuangchazi, it joins the Luokelun River, enters Suilai to the northwest, and pools in Ayar Lake.

sentences.zh: 呼圖壁原名呼圖拜克，乾隆二十二年設洛克倫巡司。

translations.literal: Huitubi was originally called Hutubiek; in the twenty-second year of Qianlong the Luokelun patrol commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: Huitubi was originally Hutubiek; in Qianlong 22 a Luokelun patrol commissioner was established.

sentences.zh: 二十八年移駐呼圖壁。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year the seat was moved to Huitubi.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 28 the office was relocated to Huitubi.

sentences.zh: 二十九年築城名景化，為巡司治所。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year a city was built named Jinghua, serving as the seat of the patrol commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 29 a city called Jinghua was built as the seat of the patrol commissioner.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十九年升縣丞。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year of Guangxu it was promoted to county assistant magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 29 the post was raised to county assistant magistrate.

sentences.zh: 驛二：寧邊、景化。

translations.literal: Two post stations: Ningbian and Jinghua.
translations.idiomatic: Post stations number two: Ningbian and Jinghua.

sentences.zh: 卡倫五。

translations.literal: Five barrier posts.
translations.idiomatic: There are five barrier posts.

sentences.zh: 呼圖壁卡倫一。

translations.literal: One Huitubi barrier post.
translations.idiomatic: There is one Huitubi barrier post.

sentences.zh: 台四。

translations.literal: Four courier stations.
translations.idiomatic: There are four courier stations.

sentences.zh: 有大回庄四。

translations.literal: There are four Muslim villages.
translations.idiomatic: Huitubi has four Muslim villages.

sentences.zh: 呼圖壁分區二十六。

translations.literal: Huitubi is divided into twenty-six districts.
translations.idiomatic: Huitubi is divided into twenty-six districts.

sentences.zh: 綏來沖，繁，難。

translations.literal: Suilai: critical, busy, difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Suilai County: critical, busy, difficult.

sentences.zh: 副將駐。

translations.literal: A brigade general is stationed.
translations.idiomatic: A brigade general is stationed there.

sentences.zh: 府西北三百四十里。

translations.literal: Three hundred forty li northwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 340 li northwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 漢，烏貪訾離及烏孫東境。

translations.literal: Han: Wuganzhi and the eastern marches of Wusun.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Han it comprised Wuganzhi and the eastern marches of Wusun.

sentences.zh: 三國，烏孫。

translations.literal: Three Kingdoms: Wusun.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Three Kingdoms it was Wusun territory.

sentences.zh: 魏，高車。

translations.literal: Wei: Gaoche.
translations.idiomatic: Under Wei it was Gaoche territory.

sentences.zh: 周，突厥。

translations.literal: Zhou: Turks.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Zhou it belonged to the Turks.

sentences.zh: 隋，西突厥、鐵勒諸地。

translations.literal: Sui: Western Turks and Tiele lands.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Sui it was Western Turk and Tiele territory.

sentences.zh: 唐，西突厥處密部內屬，隸北庭都護府。

translations.literal: Tang: the Chumi division of the Western Turks submitted and was subordinate to the Beiting Protectorate.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang the Chumi division of the Western Turks submitted and was placed under the Beiting Protectorate.

sentences.zh: 宋、元，回鶻地。

translations.literal: Song and Yuan: Uyghur lands.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song and Yuan it was Uyghur territory.

sentences.zh: 明，衛拉特。

translations.literal: Ming: Oirat.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it was Oirat territory.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十八年築綏來堡。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year of Qianlong Suilai Fort was built.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 28 Suilai Fort was built.

sentences.zh: 三十三年設縣丞。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year a county assistant magistrate was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 33 a county assistant magistrate was appointed.

sentences.zh: 四十三年於舊陽巴勒噶遜城西建二城：北康吉，南綏來，中靖遠關。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year, west of the old Yangbalegaxun city, two cities were built: Kangji to the north, Suilai to the south, with Jingyuan Pass between them.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 43 two cities were built west of old Yangbalegaxun: Kangji to the north, Suilai to the south, with Jingyuan Pass between them.

sentences.zh: 四十四年置縣，治康吉城。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year a county was established, with the seat at Kangji City.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 44 a county was established with its seat at Kangji City.

sentences.zh: 光緒十二年，合兩城為一，移治南城。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Guangxu the two cities were merged into one and the seat was moved to the southern city.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 12 the two cities were united and the seat moved to the southern city.

sentences.zh: 天山支脈，蜿蜒南境。

translations.literal: A spur of the Tianshan winds through the southern border.
translations.idiomatic: A Tianshan spur winds along the southern border.

sentences.zh: 西南：額林哈畢山、古爾班多博克達山、博羅托山。

translations.literal: Southwest: Elinhabi Mountain, Gurban Obok Daban Mountain, and Boluotuo Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest are Elinhabi Mountain, Gurban Obok Daban Mountain, and Boluotuo Mountain.

sentences.zh: 東南有甘溝山、古爾多拜山。

translations.literal: Southeast there are Gangou Mountain and Guerduobai Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast are Gangou Mountain and Guerduobai Mountain.

sentences.zh: 南有大小衛和勒晶嶺。

translations.literal: South there are the Greater and Lesser Weihelejing Ridges.
translations.idiomatic: To the south are the Greater and Lesser Weihelejing Ridges.

sentences.zh: 瑪納斯河自焉耆府北流入，亦名龍骨河，經城西，折西北，瀦為各林各土淖爾，東北流，注阿雅爾淖爾。

translations.literal: The Manas River enters from north of Yanqi Prefecture, also called the Longgu River; passing west of the city, it turns northwest, pools into Gelingetu Marsh, flows northeast, and empties into Ayar Lake.
translations.idiomatic: The Manas River enters from north of Yanqi Prefecture, also known as the Longgu River; west of the city it turns northwest, pools in Gelingetu Marsh, flows northeast, and empties into Ayar Lake.

sentences.zh: 洛克倫河自昌吉西北流入，逕沙漠，亦入阿雅爾淖爾。

translations.literal: The Luokelun River enters from northwest of Changji, crosses the desert, and also enters Ayar Lake.
translations.idiomatic: The Luokelun River enters from northwest of Changji, crosses the desert, and also flows into Ayar Lake.

sentences.zh: 和爾果斯河及安集海大小二水，皆出額林哈畢山。

translations.literal: The He'erguosi River and the greater and lesser waters of Anjihai all emerge from Elinhabi Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The He'erguosi River and the large and small Anjihai streams all rise on Elinhabi Mountain.

sentences.zh: 烏蘭烏蘇河出古爾班多博克達山。

translations.literal: The Ulan Usu River emerges from Gurban Obok Daban Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The Ulan Usu River rises on Gurban Obok Daban Mountain.

sentences.zh: 金溝水出博羅托山。

translations.literal: The Jingou water emerges from Boluotuo Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingou stream rises on Boluotuo Mountain.

sentences.zh: 塔西河出古爾多拜山。

translations.literal: The Tashi River emerges from Guerduobai Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The Tashi River rises on Guerduobai Mountain.

sentences.zh: 驛十二：在城、靖遠、樂土、烏蘭烏蘇、安集海、撞田、沙門、新渠、小拐、三岔口、唐朝渠、黃羊。

translations.literal: Twelve post stations: Zaicheng, Jingyuan, Letu, Ulan Usu, Anjihai, Zhuangtian, Shamen, Xinqu, Xiaoguai, Sanchakou, Tangchaoju, and Huangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Post stations number twelve: Zaicheng, Jingyuan, Letu, Ulan Usu, Anjihai, Zhuangtian, Shamen, Xinqu, Xiaoguai, Sanchakou, Tangchaoju, and Huangyang.

sentences.zh: 有大回庄十一。

translations.literal: There are eleven Muslim villages.
translations.idiomatic: The county has eleven Muslim villages.

sentences.zh: 卡倫七。

translations.literal: Seven barrier posts.
translations.idiomatic: There are seven barrier posts.

sentences.zh: 台五。

translations.literal: Five courier stations.
translations.idiomatic: There are five courier stations.

sentences.zh: 鎮西直隸廳：沖，繁，難。

translations.literal: Zhenxi Directly Controlled Subprefecture: critical, busy, difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenxi Directly Controlled Subprefecture: critical, busy, difficult.

sentences.zh: 隸鎮迪道。

translations.literal: Subordinate to the Zhendi Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: It is subordinate to the Zhendi Circuit.

sentences.zh: 巴里坤總兵駐。

translations.literal: The Barkul brigade commander is stationed.
translations.idiomatic: The Barkul brigade commander is stationed there.

sentences.zh: 漢，東蒲類國。

translations.literal: Han: Eastern Pulei State.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Han it was Eastern Pulei.

sentences.zh: 後漢屬伊吾盧。

translations.literal: Later Han: subordinate to Yiwulu.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Later Han it belonged to Yiwulu.

sentences.zh: 北魏屬蠕蠕。

translations.literal: Northern Wei: subordinate to Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Northern Wei it belonged to the Rouran.

sentences.zh: 隋屬突厥，後分屬西突厥。

translations.literal: Sui: subordinate to the Turks, later divided and subordinate to the Western Turks.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Sui it belonged to the Turks, later passing to the Western Turks.

sentences.zh: 唐，沙陀部與處月雜居，沙陀叛附吐蕃，徙居北庭。

translations.literal: Tang: the Shatuo tribe and the Chuyue lived mixed together; the Shatuo rebelled and submitted to Tibet, then moved to Beiting.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang the Shatuo and Chuyue lived intermixed; the Shatuo rebelled, submitted to Tibet, and moved to Beiting.

sentences.zh: 宋屬伊州，後入於遼。

translations.literal: Song: subordinate to Yizhou, later absorbed by the Liao.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song it belonged to Yizhou, later falling to the Liao.

sentences.zh: 元為別失八里東境，屬亦都護。

translations.literal: Yuan: the eastern marches of Beshbalik, subordinate to the Yidu Protector.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was the eastern marches of Beshbalik, under the Yidu Protector.

sentences.zh: 明為和碩特部地。

translations.literal: Ming: Khoshut tribal lands.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it was Khoshut territory.

sentences.zh: 明末固始汗遷青海，後為準噶爾台吉游牧地。

translations.literal: At the end of the Ming Gushri Khan moved to Qinghai; afterward it became Dzungar taiji pastureland.
translations.idiomatic: Late in the Ming Gushri Khan moved to Qinghai; afterward it became pastureland of the Dzungar taiji.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十六年，平準噶爾，阿爾泰山以東地內屬。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year of Kangxi, after pacifying the Dzungars, the lands east of the Altai submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 36, after the Dzungars were pacified, the lands east of the Altai submitted.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年，建城於巴爾庫勒，改名巴里坤。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yongzheng a city was built at Barkul and renamed Barkul.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 7 a city was built at Barkul and given the name Barkul.

sentences.zh: 九年，設安西廳同知，隸甘肅布政司。

translations.literal: In the ninth year an Anxi Subprefecture subprefect was established, subordinate to the Gansu Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 9 an Anxi Subprefecture subprefect was appointed, subordinate to the Gansu provincial administration commission.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十七年，於廳東南筑會寧城，設領隊大臣。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year of Qianlong Huining City was built southeast of the subprefecture and a contingent commanding minister was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 37 Huining City was built southeast of the subprefecture and a contingent commanding minister was appointed.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，升鎮西府，領宜禾、奇台二縣。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year it was promoted to Zhenxi Prefecture, governing the two counties of Yihe and Qitai.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 38 it was raised to Zhenxi Prefecture, governing Yihe and Qitai counties.

sentences.zh: 咸豐五年，仍為廳，移鎮迪道駐之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xianfeng it again became a subprefecture, and the Zhendi Circuit seat was moved there.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 5 it reverted to a subprefecture and the Zhendi circuit seat was moved there.

translations.idiomatic: It lies 23°36′ west of the capital meridian.

translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Sahunzi Mountain.

translations.literal: East there are Song Mountain and Qianlige Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the east are Song Mountain and Qianlige Mountain.

translations.idiomatic: Barkul Lake is Pulei Sea, northwest of the subprefecture; the Imperial Canal, Shuimo River, Gaojia Lake, and various smaller streams all drain into it.

translations.idiomatic: To the southeast the Liutiao River joins the Zhaomoduo River.

translations.idiomatic: Post stations number eight: Qudi, Kuisu, Songshutang, Suji, Xialebaquan, Wutushui, Jijicai, and Shanglebaquan.

translations.idiomatic: There are two barrier posts.

translations.idiomatic: The subprefecture is divided into twenty-four districts.

translations.idiomatic: Turfan Directly Controlled Subprefecture: critical, busy, difficult.

translations.idiomatic: It is subordinate to the Zhendi Circuit.

translations.idiomatic: The Muslim tribal prince and taiji are stationed there.

translations.literal: Han: seat of the Former Kingdom of Cheshi, later the Wuji and Jiyi colonels were established.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Han it was the seat of the Former Kingdom of Cheshi; later the Wuji and Jiyi colonels were established there.

sentences.zh: 晉治高昌，後入涼。

translations.literal: Jin: governed Gaochang, later entered Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Jin Gaochang was governed from here; later it passed to Liang.

sentences.zh: 北魏為高昌國，並於蠕蠕。

translations.literal: Northern Wei: the Gaochang state, united with Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Northern Wei it was the Gaochang state, allied with the Rouran.

translations.idiomatic: Later Kan Bozhou was made King of Gaochang; the line descended to Qu Jia, was overthrown by the Tang, and the Western Prefecture was established and elevated to the Anxi Protectorate.

sentences.zh: 貞元中，陷吐蕃。

translations.literal: In the Zhenyuan era it fell to Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhenyuan era it fell to Tibet.

sentences.zh: 五代為回鶻所據，稱西州回鶻。

translations.literal: Five Dynasties: occupied by the Uyghurs, called Western Prefecture Uyghurs.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Five Dynasties the Uyghurs held it and called it Western Prefecture Uyghur.

sentences.zh: 宋建隆二年入貢。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianlong of Song tribute was presented.
translations.idiomatic: In Song Jianlong 2 tribute was presented.

sentences.zh: 元太祖平其地，號畏吾兒，設都護，封察哈台於此。

translations.literal: Genghis Khan pacified the land, called it Uyghur, established a protector, and enfeoffed Chagatai here.
translations.idiomatic: When Genghis Khan pacified the region it was called Uyghur, a protector was established, and Chagatai was enfeoffed here.

sentences.zh: 明初為火州地，嗣稱吐魯番。

translations.literal: Early Ming: Huozhou territory; later called Turfan.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Ming it was Huozhou territory; later it came to be called Turfan.

sentences.zh: 順治三年，吐魯番阿布勒阿哈默特入貢。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shunzhi Turfan's Abdul Ahmat presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 3 Turfan's Abdul Ahmat presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 六年，助河西逆回，絕其使，尋復通。

translations.literal: In the sixth year they aided the rebellious Muslims in Hexi, cut off their envoys, and soon restored relations.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 6 they aided rebellious Muslims in Hexi, broke off relations with their envoys, and soon restored contact.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十四年，回疆平。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Kangxi the Muslim frontier was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 24 the Muslim frontier was pacified.

sentences.zh: 雍正五年內徙，安置瓜州，建城辟展。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng they were moved inward, resettled at Guazhou, and Pizhan city was built.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 the population was moved inward, resettled at Guazhou, and Pizhan city was built.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十四年，設建六城於辟展，置辦事大臣、管糧同知，仍以吐魯番廣安城為回城。

translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 24 six cities were established at Pizhan, with an affairs commissioner and a grain-administration subprefect appointed, while Turfan's Guang'an city remained the Muslim city.

sentences.zh: 回城四：曰魯克沁，曰色更木，曰哈喇和卓，曰托克遜。

translations.literal: Four Muslim cities: Lukqun, Segenmu, Karahoja, and Toksun.
translations.idiomatic: There were four Muslim cities: Lukqun, Segenmu, Karahoja, and Toksun.

sentences.zh: 合吐魯番為六城。

translations.literal: Together with Turfan they made six cities.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Turfan they formed six cities.

sentences.zh: 設阿奇木伯克理回務。

translations.literal: An Akim beg was appointed to manage Muslim affairs.
translations.idiomatic: An Akim beg was appointed to administer Muslim affairs.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，移同知駐吐魯番，並設巡檢，隸甘肅布政使司。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year the subprefect was moved to Turfan, a patrol inspector was established, and it was subordinate to the Gansu Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 44 the subprefect was posted to Turfan, a patrol inspector was appointed, and the subprefecture was placed under the Gansu Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，裁辦事大臣，改設吐魯番領隊大臣，歸烏魯木齊都統節制。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year the affairs commissioner was abolished and a Turfan brigade commander was established, subject to the Urumqi military governor.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 45 the affairs commissioner was abolished and a Turfan brigade commander was appointed under the Urumqi military governor.

sentences.zh: 光緒十年，裁領隊大臣。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Guangxu the brigade commander was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 10 the brigade commander was abolished.

sentences.zh: 十二年，置直隸廳來隸。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year it was established as a directly controlled subprefecture and placed under this jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 12 it was established as a directly controlled subprefecture and placed under this jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 西北距省治五百三十里。

translations.idiomatic: It lies 530 li northwest of the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 廣八百餘里，袤五百餘里。

translations.literal: More than eight hundred li wide and more than five hundred li long.
translations.idiomatic: It measures more than 800 li across and more than 500 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 北極高四十三度四十分。

translations.literal: Northern latitude is forty-three degrees forty minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Its northern latitude is 43°40′.

sentences.zh: 京師偏西二十六度四十五分。

translations.idiomatic: It lies 26°45′ west of the capital meridian.

sentences.zh: 領縣一。

translations.literal: It governs one county.
translations.idiomatic: It administers one county.

translations.idiomatic: The Tianshan spans the northern border as the main mountain spine.

translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Kegeda Pass.

translations.idiomatic: To the north are Dujier Mountain and Abdu'er Mountain.

sentences.zh: 西：湖洛海、合同察海、卡卡蘇各達坂。

translations.literal: West: the passes of Huluo Sea, Hetongcha Sea, and Kaka Su.
translations.idiomatic: To the west are the passes of Huluo Sea, Hetongcha Sea, and Kaka Su.

translations.idiomatic: To the south are Halake Mountain, Kumushi Pass, and Jueluotaha Mountain.

translations.idiomatic: To the southeast are Kezili, Axibulake, and Shengjintai Mountain.

translations.idiomatic: Shanshan County: critical, busy, difficult.

translations.idiomatic: It lies 250 li east of the subprefecture seat.

translations.idiomatic: Under the Han it was Loulan in the eastern marches of the Former Kingdom of Cheshi.

translations.idiomatic: After the Northern Wei it was Gaochang's Baiji city.

translations.idiomatic: Under the Song the Six Tribes here were subordinate to Gaochang; later the region passed to Liao.

translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Lukchaluru territory.

translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it was Liucheng.

translations.literal: At the end of Kangxi it submitted.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Kangxi reign it submitted.

translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 36 a Pizhan patrol inspector was appointed.

translations.idiomatic: A Tianshan spur spans the northern border, with East and West Kekoya Mountain, Maomeng Mountain, and Gaoquan Pass.

sentences.zh: 縣境諸水，出自井泉，伏流地中。

translations.idiomatic: The county's waters rise from springs and run underground.

translations.idiomatic: To the northwest are Wugequan and Jiapiquan.

translations.idiomatic: To the north is Liushuquan.

translations.literal: Southwest: Machang Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Machang Lake.

translations.literal: South: the Gobi.
translations.idiomatic: To the south lies the Gobi.

sentences.zh: 驛八：齊克滕木、土墩子、西鹽池、惠井子、梧桐窩、七個井、車箍轤、連木沁。

translations.literal: Eight post stations: Qiketengmu, Tudunzi, Xiyanchi, Huijingzi, Wutongwo, Qigejing, Chegulu, and Lianmuqin.
translations.idiomatic: Post stations number eight: Qiketengmu, Tudunzi, Xiyanchi, Huijingzi, Wutongwo, Qigejing, Chegulu, and Lianmuqin.

translations.literal: One barrier post.

translations.idiomatic: Hami Directly Controlled Subprefecture: critical, busy.

translations.idiomatic: It is subordinate to the Zhendi Circuit.

translations.literal: A brigade general is stationed.
translations.idiomatic: A brigade general is stationed there.

sentences.zh: 漢，伊吾盧地，為匈奴呼衍王庭，後置宜禾都尉。

translations.idiomatic: Under the Han it was Yiwulu territory, seat of the Xiongnu Huyan king; later the Yihe Colonel was established there.

sentences.zh: 三國屬鮮卑西部。

translations.literal: Three Kingdoms: subordinate to the Western Xianbei.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Three Kingdoms it belonged to the Western Xianbei.

sentences.zh: 晉屬敦煌郡。

translations.literal: Jin: subordinate to Dunhuang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Jin it belonged to Dunhuang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 北魏屬蠕蠕。

translations.literal: Northern Wei: subordinate to Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Northern Wei it belonged to the Rouran.

sentences.zh: 隋築新城，號新伊吾，後屬西突厥。

translations.literal: Sui: a new city was built called New Yiwu; later it belonged to the Western Turks.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Sui a new city was built called New Yiwu; later it passed to the Western Turks.

sentences.zh: 唐貞觀四年，置西伊州，尋改伊州，置都督府。

translations.idiomatic: In Tang Zhenguan 4 Western Yizhou was established; soon it was renamed Yizhou and a Protector Office was installed.

sentences.zh: 天寶初，改伊吾郡，尋復初。

translations.idiomatic: Early in the Tianbao era it was renamed Yiwu Commandery; soon the former name was restored.

sentences.zh: 廣德後，陷吐蕃。

translations.literal: After Guangde it fell to Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: After the Guangde era it fell to Tibet.

sentences.zh: 五代時，號胡盧磧。

translations.literal: In the Five Dynasties era it was called Hulud Desert.
translations.idiomatic: During the Five Dynasties it was known as Hulud Desert.

sentences.zh: 宋雍熙後，屬回鶻，元屬畏吾兒，後為宗室納勿里封地。

translations.idiomatic: After Song Yongxi it belonged to the Uyghurs; under the Yuan to the Uyghurs; later it became the enfeoffment of the imperial clansman Nafoli.

translations.idiomatic: In Ming Yongle 4 Hami Guard was established.

translations.idiomatic: During the Zhengde reign it submitted to Turfan.

translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 4 the commander of Hami Guard, Huihe'er, presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 六年，以助逆絕貢，復通。

translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 6, for aiding rebels tribute was cut off; relations were later restored.

translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 36 Sebuteng Balzhuer was captured and presented, and the Ebedula zasak seal was granted.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，編列旗隊，設管旗章京。

translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 37 banner companies were organized and a banner-managing associate was appointed.

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，始建城。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng the city was first built.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 the city was first built.

sentences.zh: 回城在城西三里，回子郡王所居，康熙五十六年築。
