translations.idiomatic: The Muslim city stands three li west of the garrison city, residence of the Muslim prince; it was built in Kangxi 56.

sentences.zh: 設協辦旗務伯克。

translations.literal: An assistant managing banner affairs beg was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: An assistant beg managing banner affairs was appointed.

sentences.zh: 十三年，設駐防兵。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year garrison troops were established.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 13 garrison troops were posted.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十二年，准部平，其酋伊薩克內附，移靖逆、瓜州、黃墩各營駐之，撤駐防兵。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Qianlong the Dzungars were pacified; their chief Isaac submitted; the Jingni, Guazhou, and Huangdun camps were moved to garrison there, and the garrison troops were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 22 the Dzungars were pacified; their chief Isaac submitted; the Jingni, Guazhou, and Huangdun garrisons were transferred there, and the standing garrison was withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，設辦事大臣、協辦大臣、撫民通判、巡檢，隸甘肅布政司。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year an affairs commissioner, assistant commissioner, civilian-pacification subprefect, and patrol inspector were established; it was subordinate to the Gansu Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 24 an affairs commissioner, assistant commissioner, civilian-pacification subprefect, and patrol inspector were appointed, and the subprefecture was placed under the Gansu Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 光緒十年，升直隸廳。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Guangxu it was promoted to a directly controlled subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 10 it was promoted to a directly controlled subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 十二年來隸。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year it came under this jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 12 it was placed under this jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 西北距省治一千六百二十里。

translations.literal: One thousand six hundred twenty li northwest of the provincial seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 1,620 li northwest of the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 廣四百五十餘里，袤二百五十里。

translations.literal: More than four hundred fifty li wide and two hundred fifty li long.
translations.idiomatic: It measures more than 450 li across and 250 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 北極高四十二度五十三分。

translations.literal: Northern latitude is forty-two degrees fifty-three minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Its northern latitude is 42°53′.

sentences.zh: 京師偏西二十二度三十四分。

translations.literal: Twenty-two degrees thirty-four minutes west of the capital meridian.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 22°34′ west of the capital meridian.

sentences.zh: 北：天山。

translations.literal: North: the Tianshan.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Tianshan.

sentences.zh: 其分支，西北：截達坂、沙克拉山、可雅爾達坂、合塔手可拉山。

translations.literal: Its spurs, northwest: Jieda Pass, Shakela Mountain, Keyar Pass, and Hetashoukel Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Its spurs to the northwest include Jieda Pass, Shakela Mountain, Keyar Pass, and Hetashoukel Mountain.

sentences.zh: 東北：阿克相木山、坤翌圖山、阿里鐵洛可山、空多洛托山。

translations.literal: Northeast: Akexiangmu Mountain, Kunyitu Mountain, Alitieluoke Mountain, and Kongduoluotuo Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast are Akexiangmu Mountain, Kunyitu Mountain, Alitieluoke Mountain, and Kongduoluotuo Mountain.

sentences.zh: 哈密河出廳西蘇巴什湖，南流瀦為小南湖，又南流，東為碩洛浣，西為阿里浣，折西南，瀦為大泉海子，為沙漠所滲。

translations.literal: The Hami River emerges from Subashi Lake west of the subprefecture, flows south and pools into Little South Lake; flowing south again, east it becomes Shuoluo Marsh and west Ali Marsh; turning southwest it pools into Daquan Haizi Lake and is absorbed by the desert.
translations.idiomatic: The Hami River rises at Subashi Lake west of the subprefecture, flows south into Little South Lake, then south again; to the east it becomes Shuoluo Marsh and to the west Ali Marsh; turning southwest it pools in Daquan Haizi Lake and is swallowed by the desert.

sentences.zh: 東：乾河子。

translations.literal: East: Ganhezi.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Ganhezi.

sentences.zh: 東北：烏拉台水、安吉水、黑具瑪水、達子湖。

translations.literal: Northeast: Ulatai water, Anji water, Heijuma water, and Dazi Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast are Ulatai water, Anji water, Heijuma water, and Dazi Lake.

sentences.zh: 西：依他拉可水、八道溝等水。

translations.literal: West: Yitalake water, Badaogou, and other waters.
translations.idiomatic: To the west are Yitalake water, Badaogou, and other streams.

sentences.zh: 南：戈壁。

translations.literal: South: the Gobi.
translations.idiomatic: To the south lies the Gobi.

sentences.zh: 驛十四：伊吾、南山口、黃蘆岡、長流水、格子煙墩、苦水、沙泉子、星星峽、頭堡、三堡、三道嶺、瞭墩、橙槽溝、一碗泉。

translations.literal: Fourteen post stations: Yiwu, Nanshankou, Huanglugang, Changliushui, Gezi Yandun, Kushui, Shaquanzi, Xingxingxia, Toubao, Sanbao, Sandao Ling, Liaodun, Chengcao Gou, and Yiwangquan.
translations.idiomatic: Post stations number fourteen: Yiwu, Nanshankou, Huanglugang, Changliushui, Gezi Yandun, Kushui, Shaquanzi, Xingxingxia, Toubao, Sanbao, Sandao Ling, Liaodun, Chengcao Gou, and Yiwangquan.

sentences.zh: 新城，巡司一。

translations.literal: New city: one patrol commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: At the new city there is one patrol commissioner.

sentences.zh: 廳境分區三十五。

translations.literal: The subprefecture jurisdiction is divided into thirty-five districts.
translations.idiomatic: The subprefecture is divided into thirty-five districts.

sentences.zh: 有大回庄十四。

translations.literal: There are fourteen large Muslim villages.
translations.idiomatic: The subprefecture has fourteen large Muslim villages.

sentences.zh: 光緒七年，俄約定為商埠。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Guangxu, by treaty with Russia it was designated a treaty port.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 7 a treaty with Russia designated it a treaty port.

sentences.zh: 庫爾喀喇烏蘇直隸廳：沖，繁，難。

translations.literal: Kuerkala Usu Directly Controlled Subprefecture: critical, busy, difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Kuerkala Usu Directly Controlled Subprefecture: critical, busy, difficult.

sentences.zh: 隸鎮迪道。

translations.literal: Subordinate to the Zhendi Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: It is subordinate to the Zhendi Circuit.

sentences.zh: 辦事、領隊大臣駐。

translations.literal: The affairs and brigade commanders are stationed.
translations.idiomatic: The affairs commissioner and brigade commander are stationed there.

sentences.zh: 漢，匈奴西境。

translations.literal: Han: the western marches of the Xiongnu.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Han it was the western marches of the Xiongnu.

sentences.zh: 晉後為鐵勒部。

translations.literal: After the Jin it was Tiele territory.
translations.idiomatic: After the Jin it was Tiele territory.

sentences.zh: 北周屬突厥。

translations.literal: Northern Zhou: subordinate to the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Northern Zhou it belonged to the Turks.

sentences.zh: 隋屬西突厥，為處木昆部。

translations.literal: Sui: subordinate to the Western Turks, the Chumukun division.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Sui it belonged to the Western Turks, in the Chumukun division.

sentences.zh: 唐永徽中破之，設郡縣，屬昆陵都護府。

translations.literal: In the Yonghui era of Tang, [the court] defeated them, established commanderies and counties, and placed the region under the Kunling Protectorate.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yonghui era of Tang the court defeated them, established commanderies and counties, and placed the region under the Kunling Protectorate.

sentences.zh: 開元中，置瀚海軍。

translations.literal: In the Kaiyuan era, the Hanhai Army was established.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kaiyuan era an Hanhai Army garrison was established.

sentences.zh: 後唐時屬遼。

translations.literal: Later Tang: subordinate to Liao.
translations.idiomatic: Under Later Tang it belonged to Liao.

sentences.zh: 元，回鶻地。

translations.literal: Yuan: Uyghur territory.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Uyghur territory.

sentences.zh: 明，綽羅斯部地，後屬準噶爾。

translations.literal: Ming: Zhuluosi tribal territory; later subordinate to the Dzungars.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it was Zhuluosi tribal territory; later it belonged to the Dzungars.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十二年，平準部。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 22 the Dzungar department was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 22 the Dzungar department was pacified.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，設辦事大臣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year an affairs commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 27 an affairs commissioner was appointed.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，築慶綏城。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year Qingsui City was built.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 28 Qingsui City was built.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，設領隊大臣、縣丞。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year a brigade commander and county assistant were established.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 37 a brigade commander and county assistant were appointed.

sentences.zh: 四十六年，設同知。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year a subprefect was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 46 a subprefect was appointed.

sentences.zh: 明年設游擊。

translations.literal: The next year a brigade vice-commander was established.
translations.idiomatic: The following year a brigade vice-commander was appointed.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，築新城，定今名，設糧員，裁縣丞。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year a new city was built, the present name was fixed, a grain officer was established, and the county assistant was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 48 a new city was built and the present name was fixed; a grain officer was appointed and the county assistant was abolished.

sentences.zh: 隸烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: Subordinate to the Urumqi commandant-general.
translations.idiomatic: It was placed under the Urumqi commandant-general.

sentences.zh: 光緒十二年，裁糧員，置直隸廳，改隸。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 12 the grain officer was abolished, a directly controlled subprefecture was established, and its subordination was changed.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 12 the grain officer was abolished, a directly controlled subprefecture was established, and its administrative subordination was changed.

sentences.zh: 東距省治七百里。

translations.literal: Seven hundred li east of the provincial seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 700 li east of the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 廣三百三十里，袤五百四十里。

translations.literal: Three hundred thirty li wide and five hundred forty li long.
translations.idiomatic: It measures 330 li across and 540 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 北極高四十四度三十分。

translations.literal: Northern latitude is forty-four degrees thirty minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Its northern latitude is 44°30′.

sentences.zh: 京師偏西三十一度。

translations.literal: Thirty-one degrees west of the capital meridian.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 31° west of the capital meridian.

sentences.zh: 天山支脈在境南者，額林哈畢爾噶、托羅滾、沙得格果沙吐克土諸山，額布圖、古爾班、恰克、額爾圖諸嶺。

translations.literal: Branches of the Tianshan within the southern part of the jurisdiction include the mountains Elinhabierga, Tuoluogun, and Shadegeguoshatuketu, and the ridges Ebutu, Gu'erban, Qiake, and E'ertu.
translations.idiomatic: Within the southern part of the jurisdiction lie branches of the Tianshan: the mountains Elinhabierga, Tuoluogun, and Shadegeguoshatuketu, and the ridges Ebutu, Gu'erban, Qiake, and E'ertu.

sentences.zh: 奎屯河出托羅滾山，合托羅滾水、熱水泉、沙格得水，北流，至城東，分二支渠，至二台驛，折西流，與濟爾噶朗河會。

translations.literal: The Kuitun River emerges from Tuoluogun Mountain, joins the Tuoluogun stream, Hot Spring, and Shagede water, flows north to the east of the city, divides into two branch canals, reaches Ertai post station, turns west, and joins the Jiergalang River.
translations.idiomatic: The Kuitun River rises in Tuoluogun Mountain and receives the Tuoluogun stream, Hot Spring, and Shagede water; flowing north to the east of the city it splits into two branch canals and, reaching Ertai post station, turns west to join the Jiergalang River.

sentences.zh: 濟爾噶朗河出古爾班嶺，合札哈水、東斗水、哈峽圖水，北流，會奎屯河，又西流，入精河廳，與固爾圖河會。

translations.literal: The Jiergalang River emerges from Gu'erban Ridge, joins Zhaha water, Dongdou water, and Haxiatu water, flows north, meets the Kuitun River, again flows west into Jinghe Subprefecture, and joins the Gu'ertu River.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiergalang River rises in Gu'erban Ridge and receives Zhaha water, Dongdou water, and Haxiatu water; flowing north to meet the Kuitun River, it turns west into Jinghe Subprefecture and joins the Gu'ertu River.

sentences.zh: 固爾圖河出額爾圖嶺，有五源，合北流，折西入精河廳，與金屯河會。

translations.literal: The Gu'ertu River emerges from E'ertu Ridge, has five sources, joins and flows north, turns west into Jinghe Subprefecture, and meets the Jintun River.
translations.idiomatic: The Gu'ertu River rises in E'ertu Ridge from five headwaters; after they merge it flows north, turns west into Jinghe Subprefecture, and joins the Jintun River.

sentences.zh: 西流，瀦於喀喇塔拉阿西柯淖爾。

translations.literal: Flowing west, it pools in Karatala Axi Ke Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Flowing west, it pools in Karatala Axi Ke Lake.

sentences.zh: 精河巡司一。

translations.literal: One Jinghe patrol commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: There is one Jinghe patrol commissioner.

sentences.zh: 驛九：西湖、奎屯、普爾塔齊墩、木達、固爾圖、頭台、二台、小草湖、鄂倫布拉克。

translations.literal: Nine post stations: Xihu, Kuitun, Pu'ertaqidun, Muda, Gu'ertu, Toutai, Ertai, Xiaocaohu, and Elunbulake.
translations.idiomatic: Post stations number nine: Xihu, Kuitun, Pu'ertaqidun, Muda, Gu'ertu, Toutai, Ertai, Xiaocaohu, and Elunbulake.

sentences.zh: 廳境分區九。

translations.literal: The subprefecture jurisdiction is divided into nine districts.
translations.idiomatic: The subprefecture is divided into nine districts.

sentences.zh: 有舊土爾扈特部游牧地。

translations.literal: There is nomadic pastureland of the former Torghut tribe.
translations.idiomatic: There is pasturage of the former Torghut tribe.

sentences.zh: 卡倫一。

translations.literal: One barrier post.
translations.idiomatic: There is one barrier post.

sentences.zh: 伊犁府：沖，繁，疲，難。

translations.literal: Ili Prefecture: critical, busy, strained, difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Ili Prefecture: critical, busy, strained, and difficult.

sentences.zh: 隸伊塔道。

translations.literal: Subordinate to the Yita Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: It is subordinate to the Yita Circuit.

sentences.zh: 漢至晉為烏孫、伊烈兩國地，後入鐵勒。

translations.literal: From Han through Jin it was the land of the Wusun and Yilie states; later it passed to the Tiele.
translations.idiomatic: From Han through Jin it was the territory of the Wusun and Yilie states; later it passed to the Tiele.

sentences.zh: 北魏，悅般國，又車高地。

translations.literal: Northern Wei: the Yueban state, also Chegao territory.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Northern Wei it was the Yueban state and also Chegao territory.

sentences.zh: 周，突厥地。

translations.literal: Zhou: Turk territory.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Zhou it was Turk territory.

sentences.zh: 隋，西突厥及石國。

translations.literal: Sui: the Western Turks and Shiguo.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Sui it belonged to the Western Turks and Shiguo.

sentences.zh: 唐，西突厥及回鶻地，又西境為突厥施烏質勒部，又西突厥及笯赤建國、石國地。

translations.literal: Tang: Western Turk and Uyghur territory; its western border was the Tujue Shi Wuzhile division; also Western Turk territory and the lands of the Nuo Chijian state and Shiguo.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it was Western Turk and Uyghur territory; its western marches were held by the Tujue Shi Wuzhile division, and farther west by the Western Turks and the states of Nuo Chijian and Shiguo.

sentences.zh: 大曆後，葛邏祿居之。

translations.literal: After the Dali era the Qarluq dwelt there.
translations.idiomatic: After the Dali era the Qarluq settled there.

sentences.zh: 宋為烏孫，後入遼。

translations.literal: Song: Wusun territory; later it passed to Liao.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song it was Wusun territory; later it passed to Liao.

sentences.zh: 元名阿力麻里，為諸王海都行營處。

translations.literal: Under the Yuan it was called Alimali and served as the princes' summer encampment at the imperial capital.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was called Alimali and served as a summer encampment for the princes.

sentences.zh: 明，綽羅斯部，後屬準噶爾。

translations.literal: Ming: the Zhuluosi tribe; later subordinate to the Dzungars.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it was Zhuluosi tribal territory; later it belonged to the Dzungars.

sentences.zh: 乾隆時，准部平，改烏哈爾里克為伊犁。

translations.literal: During Qianlong the Dzungar department was pacified and Uhailike was changed to Yili.
translations.idiomatic: During Qianlong the Dzungar department was pacified and Uhailike was renamed Yili.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，設辦事大臣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year an affairs commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 25 an affairs commissioner was appointed.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，設將軍，節制南北兩路，以參贊大臣副之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year a general was established to command the northern and southern routes, with an assistant commissioner as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 27 a general was appointed to command both the northern and southern routes, assisted by a commissioner.

sentences.zh: 初設二員，尋裁一。

translations.literal: Two posts were initially established; soon one was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Two were initially appointed; soon one post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，設錫伯營、索倫、察哈爾領隊大臣各一。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year one brigade commander each was established for the Xibe camp, the Solon, and the Chahar.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 29 brigade commanders were appointed for the Xibe camp, the Solon, and the Chahar, one for each.

sentences.zh: 三十年，設額魯特領隊大臣。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year an Olot brigade commander was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 30 an Olot brigade commander was appointed.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，設惠寧城領隊大臣。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year a Huining City brigade commander was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 34 a brigade commander for Huining City was appointed.

sentences.zh: 築河北九城。

translations.literal: Nine cities north of the river were built.
translations.idiomatic: Nine cities were built north of the river.

sentences.zh: 曰惠遠，將軍、參贊大臣、各營領隊大臣駐。

translations.literal: One called Huiyuan: the general, assistant commissioner, and brigade commanders of each camp were stationed there.
translations.idiomatic: One was called Huiyuan, where the general, the assistant commissioner, and the brigade commanders of each camp were stationed.

sentences.zh: 總兵先駐綏定，尋移駐。

translations.literal: The brigade commander was first stationed at Suiding; soon he moved his headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: The brigade commander was first stationed at Suiding; soon he moved his headquarters.

sentences.zh: 理事同知、撫民同知、巡司各一。

translations.literal: One judicial subprefect, one civilian-pacification subprefect, and one patrol commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: There was one judicial subprefect, one civilian-pacification subprefect, and one patrol commissioner.

sentences.zh: 改巴顏岱曰惠寧，領隊大臣駐，糧員、巡司各一。

translations.literal: Bayandai was changed to Huining; a brigade commander was stationed there, with one grain officer and one patrol commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Bayandai was renamed Huining, with a brigade commander stationed there and one grain officer and one patrol commissioner.

sentences.zh: 改烏哈爾里克曰綏定，總兵駐，糧員、巡司各一。

translations.literal: Uhailike was changed to Suiding; the brigade commander was stationed there, with one grain officer and one patrol commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Uhailike was renamed Suiding, with the brigade commander stationed there and one grain officer and one patrol commissioner.

sentences.zh: 改烏克爾博羅素克曰廣仁，屯鎮左營游擊駐。

translations.literal: Wuke'erbolosuoke was changed to Guangren; the garrison left-battalion vice-commander was stationed there.
translations.idiomatic: Wuke'erbolosuoke was renamed Guangren, where the garrison left-battalion vice-commander was stationed.

sentences.zh: 改察罕烏蘇曰瞻德，都司、守備駐。

translations.literal: Chahan Usu was changed to Zhande; a regimental commander and garrison commander were stationed there.
translations.idiomatic: Chahan Usu was renamed Zhande, where a regimental commander and a garrison commander were stationed.

sentences.zh: 改霍爾果斯曰拱宸，參將駐，巡司一。

translations.literal: Huo'erguosi was changed to Gongchen; a vice-general was stationed there, with one patrol commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Huo'erguosi was renamed Gongchen, with a vice-general stationed there and one patrol commissioner.

sentences.zh: 改哈拉布拉克曰熙春，屯鎮都司駐，曰塔勒奇，屯鎮守備駐。

translations.literal: Halaburake was changed to Xichun, with the garrison regimental commander stationed there; another called Talerqi, with the garrison garrison commander stationed there.
translations.idiomatic: Halaburake was renamed Xichun, where the garrison regimental commander was stationed; another was called Talerqi, where the garrison commander was stationed.

sentences.zh: 改固勒扎曰寧遠，以居回民。

translations.literal: Gulezha was changed to Ningyuan to house Muslim people.
translations.idiomatic: Gulezha was renamed Ningyuan to settle Muslim residents.

sentences.zh: 設阿奇木伯克、伊什罕伯克各一。

translations.literal: One Aqim Beg and one Ishhan Beg were established.
translations.idiomatic: An Aqim Beg and an Ishhan Beg were appointed.

sentences.zh: 糧員一。

translations.literal: One grain officer.
translations.idiomatic: There is one grain officer.

sentences.zh: 同治五年陷回。

translations.literal: In Tongzhi 5 it fell to Muslim rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 5 it fell to the Muslim rebels.

sentences.zh: 後又為俄佔。

translations.literal: Later it was again occupied by Russia.
translations.idiomatic: Later it was occupied by Russia as well.

sentences.zh: 光緒初，全疆底定。

translations.literal: In the early Guangxu era all of Xinjiang was settled.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Guangxu era all of Xinjiang was pacified.

sentences.zh: 八年，收回伊犁。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Yili was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 8 Yili was recovered.

sentences.zh: 十四年，以綏定城置府。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year a prefecture was established at Suiding City.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 14 a prefecture was established at Suiding City.

sentences.zh: 將軍，副都統，參贊大臣，領隊大臣，索倫、額魯特、察哈爾、錫伯各領隊大臣，及滿洲八旗軍標副將，理事同知，同駐惠遠城。

translations.literal: The general, vice commandant-general, assistant commissioner, brigade commanders, the Solon, Olot, Chahar, and Xibe brigade commanders, the Manchu Eight Banners army standard vice-general, and the judicial subprefect were all stationed at Huiyuan City.
translations.idiomatic: The general, vice commandant-general, assistant commissioner, brigade commanders, the Solon, Olot, Chahar, and Xibe brigade commanders, the Manchu Eight Banners army standard vice-general, and the judicial subprefect were all stationed at Huiyuan City.

sentences.zh: 參將、霍爾果斯通判駐拱宸城。

translations.literal: The vice-general and the Huo'erguosi subprefect were stationed at Gongchen City.
translations.idiomatic: The vice-general and the Huo'erguosi subprefect were stationed at Gongchen City.

sentences.zh: 游擊駐廣仁城。

translations.literal: The brigade vice-commander was stationed at Guangren City.
translations.idiomatic: The brigade vice-commander was stationed at Guangren City.

sentences.zh: 守備駐瞻德城。

translations.literal: The garrison commander was stationed at Zhande City.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison commander was stationed at Zhande City.

sentences.zh: 都司駐熙春城。

translations.literal: The regimental commander was stationed at Xichun City.
translations.idiomatic: The regimental commander was stationed at Xichun City.

sentences.zh: 東距省治一千五百四十五里。

translations.literal: One thousand five hundred forty-five li east of the provincial seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 1,545 li east of the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 廣一千五百餘里，袤一千一百餘里。

translations.literal: More than one thousand five hundred li wide and more than one thousand one hundred li long.
translations.idiomatic: It measures more than 1,500 li across and more than 1,100 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 北極高四十三度五十六分。

translations.literal: Northern latitude is forty-three degrees fifty-six minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Its northern latitude is 43°56′.

sentences.zh: 京師偏西三十四度二十分。

translations.literal: Thirty-four degrees twenty minutes west of the capital meridian.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 34°20′ west of the capital meridian.

sentences.zh: 領縣二。

translations.literal: It governs two counties.
translations.idiomatic: It administers two counties.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，俄約定為商埠。

translations.literal: In Xianfeng 1, by treaty with Russia it was designated a treaty port.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 1 a treaty with Russia designated it a treaty port.

sentences.zh: 綏定沖，繁，疲，難。

translations.literal: Suiding: critical, busy, strained, difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Suiding: critical, busy, strained, and difficult.

sentences.zh: 倚。

translations.literal: Attached to the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Attached to the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十六年設巡檢。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 26 a patrol inspector was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 26 a patrol inspector was appointed.

sentences.zh: 光緒十四年置，移巡檢駐廣仁城。

translations.literal: Established in Guangxu 14; the patrol inspector was moved to Guangren City.
translations.idiomatic: It was established in Guangxu 14, and the patrol inspector was moved to Guangren City.

sentences.zh: 天山支脈綿亙北境。

translations.literal: Branches of the Tianshan extend continuously across the northern border.
translations.idiomatic: Branches of the Tianshan run continuously across the northern border.

sentences.zh: 北：塔勒奇山。

translations.literal: North: Talerqi Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Talerqi Mountain.

sentences.zh: 東北：新開達坂、庫森木什達坂。

translations.literal: Northeast: Xinkai Pass and Kushenmushi Pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast are Xinkai Pass and Kushenmushi Pass.

sentences.zh: 伊犁河自寧遠西北流入。

translations.literal: The Yili River flows in from the northwest of Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: The Yili River enters from the northwest of Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 通惠渠南北二渠，烏拉果克水、大西溝、察罕爾烏蘇水皆注之，又西至河源卡，會霍爾果斯河，西流入俄界。

translations.literal: The north and south channels of the Tonghui Canal; Wulagoke water, Daxigou, and Chahan'er Usu water all pour into it; again west to Heyuankou barrier it meets the Huo'erguosi River and flows west into Russian territory.
translations.idiomatic: The north and south channels of the Tonghui Canal receive Wulagoke water, Daxigou, and Chahan'er Usu water; farther west, at Heyuankou barrier, the stream meets the Huo'erguosi River and flows west into Russian territory.

sentences.zh: 南：大小博羅庄水、霍洛海庄水、沙拉諾海水、洪海水，均北流入沙磧。

translations.literal: South: the large and small Bolozhuang streams, Huoluohai village stream, Shalanohai stream, and Honghai stream all flow north into sandy desert.
translations.idiomatic: To the south, the large and small Bolozhuang streams, Huoluohai village stream, Shalanohai stream, and Honghai stream all flow north into the sandy desert.

sentences.zh: 又東西阿里瑪圖水，北大小東溝水，亦入沙磧。

translations.literal: Also the east-west Alimatu stream and the northern large and small Donggou streams likewise enter the sandy desert.
translations.idiomatic: The east-west Alimatu stream and the northern large and small Donggou streams also empty into the sandy desert.

sentences.zh: 北：賽里木淖爾。

translations.literal: North: Sailimu Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Sailimu Lake.

sentences.zh: 驛七：沙泉子、惠遠城、蘆草溝、塔爾奇阿滿鄂博、勒齊爾鄂勒著衣圖博木、胡素圖布拉克。

translations.literal: Seven post stations: Shaquanzi, Huiyuan City, Lucaogou, Talerqi Aman Ebo, Leqi'er E'lezhuoyitu Bomu, and Husutubulake.
translations.idiomatic: Post stations number seven: Shaquanzi, Huiyuan City, Lucaogou, Talerqi Aman Ebo, Leqi'er E'lezhuoyitu Bomu, and Husutubulake.

sentences.zh: 台站一，屬錫伯營，回庄十六。

translations.literal: One relay station, belonging to the Xibe camp; sixteen Muslim villages.
translations.idiomatic: There is one relay station under the Xibe camp and sixteen Muslim villages.

sentences.zh: 額魯特部上三旗、下五旗，及察哈爾部游牧地。

translations.literal: The Olot tribe's upper three banners and lower five banners, and Chahar tribal nomadic pastureland.
translations.idiomatic: There is pasturage of the Olot tribe's upper three banners and lower five banners, and of the Chahar tribe.

sentences.zh: 卡倫十三，為中、俄交界，歸額魯特、錫伯營分轄。

translations.literal: Thirteen barrier posts forming the Sino-Russian border, under divided jurisdiction of the Olot and Xibe camps.
translations.idiomatic: There are thirteen barrier posts on the Sino-Russian border, under the divided jurisdiction of the Olot and Xibe camps.

sentences.zh: 牌博自南而西至西北，均連俄界。

translations.literal: Boundary markers from south westward to northwest all connect to the Russian border.
translations.idiomatic: Boundary markers from the south westward to the northwest all adjoin the Russian border.

sentences.zh: 自沙拉諾海小山立第十六牌博，至頭胡第二十五牌博，凡十。

translations.literal: From Shalanohai hill, where the sixteenth boundary marker was erected, to Touhu, the twenty-fifth boundary marker, ten in all.
translations.idiomatic: From the sixteenth boundary marker erected at Shalanohai hill to the twenty-fifth at Touhu, there are ten in all.

sentences.zh: 寧遠繁，難。

translations.literal: Ningyuan: busy, difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Ningyuan: busy and difficult.

sentences.zh: 府東南一百二十里。

translations.literal: One hundred twenty li southeast of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 120 li southeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 伊塔道治所。

translations.literal: Seat of the Yita Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: It is the seat of the Yita Circuit.

sentences.zh: 乾隆間，築寧遠城於固勒札。

translations.literal: During Qianlong Ningyuan City was built at Gulezha.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qianlong era Ningyuan City was built at Gulezha.

sentences.zh: 光緒八年設同知，十四年改置。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 8 a subprefect was established; in the fourteenth year it was reorganized.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 8 a subprefect was appointed; in Guangxu 14 the county was reorganized.

sentences.zh: 東南：博羅布爾噶蘇山、哈什山、大蒙柯圖山、烏土達坂、木尼克得山、額林哈必爾山、克里克子達坂。

translations.literal: Southeast: Boluo Bu'ergasu Mountain, Hashi Mountain, Damengketu Mountain, Wutu Pass, Muniikede Mountain, Elinhabier Mountain, and Kelikezi Pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast are Boluo Bu'ergasu Mountain, Hashi Mountain, Damengketu Mountain, Wutu Pass, Muniikede Mountain, Elinhabier Mountain, and Kelikezi Pass.

sentences.zh: 南：索達坂、色格三達坂。

translations.literal: South: Suo Pass and Sege San Pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the south are Suo Pass and Sege San Pass.

sentences.zh: 西南：喀喇套山、格登山、汗騰格里山、沙拉套山、諾海托蓋山。

translations.literal: Southwest: Karatao Mountain, Gerdeng Mountain, Hantenggri Mountain, Shalatao Mountain, and Nuohaituogai Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest are Karatao Mountain, Gerdeng Mountain, Hantenggri Mountain, Shalatao Mountain, and Nuohaituogai Mountain.

sentences.zh: 特克斯河出俄屬木薩爾山，自胡素圖卡南、諾海托蓋山北入，折東流，納戛雄河、大小霍洛海諸水，又東與崆吉斯河會。

translations.literal: The Tekes River emerges from Musar Mountain in Russian territory, enters from the south of Husutuka and north of Nuohaituogai Mountain, turns east, receives the Gaxiong River and the large and small Huoluohai streams, and farther east joins the Kongjisi River.
translations.idiomatic: The Tekes River rises in Musar Mountain in Russian territory and enters from south of Husutuka and north of Nuohaituogai Mountain; turning east it receives the Gaxiong River and the large and small Huoluohai streams, then joins the Kongjisi River farther east.

sentences.zh: 崆吉斯河自焉耆西北流入，逕耶里格庄南，合特克斯河，西流，至阿瓦克庄西，與哈什河會。

translations.literal: The Kongjisi River flows in from the northwest of Yanqi, passes south of Yelige Village, joins the Tekes River, flows west to west of Awake Village, and meets the Hashi River.
translations.idiomatic: The Kongjisi River enters from northwest Yanqi, passes south of Yelige Village, and joins the Tekes River; flowing west to west of Awake Village, it meets the Hashi River.

sentences.zh: 哈什河源出大蒙柯圖山，西流，納十二圍場水、皇渠、錫伯營渠，合西北流，為伊犁河，入綏定。

translations.literal: The Hashi River's source emerges from Damengketu Mountain, flows west, receives the Twelve Enclosure streams, the Imperial Canal, and the Xibe Camp Canal, joins and flows northwest, becomes the Yili River, and enters Suide.
translations.idiomatic: The Hashi River rises in Damengketu Mountain and flows west, receiving the Twelve Enclosure streams, the Imperial Canal, and the Xibe Camp Canal; after merging it flows northwest as the Yili River and enters Suide.

sentences.zh: 北：賽里木淖爾。

translations.literal: North: Sailimu Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Sailimu Lake.

sentences.zh: 驛一：在城。

translations.literal: One post station: at the city.
translations.idiomatic: There is one post station in the city.

sentences.zh: 台站七，屬錫伯營。

translations.literal: Seven relay stations, belonging to the Xibe camp.
translations.idiomatic: There are seven relay stations under the Xibe camp.

sentences.zh: 回庄三十七。

translations.literal: Thirty-seven Muslim villages.
translations.idiomatic: There are thirty-seven Muslim villages.

sentences.zh: 額魯特游牧地。

translations.literal: Olot nomadic pastureland.
translations.idiomatic: There is pasturage of the Olot tribe.

sentences.zh: 卡倫七，為中、俄交界，歸額魯特營轄。

translations.literal: Seven barrier posts forming the Sino-Russian border, under jurisdiction of the Olot camp.
translations.idiomatic: There are seven barrier posts on the Sino-Russian border, under the jurisdiction of the Olot camp.

sentences.zh: 縣境由南而西均界俄。

translations.literal: The county border from south westward all borders Russia.
translations.idiomatic: From the south westward the county border all adjoins Russia.

sentences.zh: 自納林哈勒噶立第一牌博，至阿哩千谷第十五牌博，凡十五。

translations.literal: From the first boundary marker at Nalinhalegali to the fifteenth at Aligian Valley, fifteen in all.
translations.idiomatic: From the first boundary marker at Nalinhalegali to the fifteenth at Aligian Valley, there are fifteen in all.

sentences.zh: 塔爾巴哈台直隸廳：繁，疲，難。

translations.literal: Tarbagatai Directly Controlled Subprefecture: busy, strained, difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Tarbagatai Directly Controlled Subprefecture: busy, strained, and difficult.

sentences.zh: 隸伊塔道。

translations.literal: Subordinate to the Yita Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: It is subordinate to the Yita Circuit.

sentences.zh: 塔城左翼副都統、參贊大臣、領隊大臣、副將駐。

translations.literal: The Tarbagatai Left-Flank Vice Commander-in-Chief, the Commissioner for Affairs, the Brigade Commander, and the Vice-General are stationed here.
translations.idiomatic: The Tarbagatai Left-Flank Vice Commander-in-Chief, the Commissioner for Affairs, the Brigade Commander, and the Vice-General are stationed here.

sentences.zh: 漢，匈奴右地。

translations.literal: Han: the Xiongnu western domain.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Han it was the Xiongnu western domain.

sentences.zh: 三國，鮮卑右部。

translations.literal: Three Kingdoms: the Xianbei western division.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Three Kingdoms period it belonged to the Xianbei western division.

sentences.zh: 北魏，高車、蠕蠕地。

translations.literal: Northern Wei: Gaoche and Rouran territory.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Northern Wei it was Gaoche and Rouran territory.

sentences.zh: 北周、隋，屬突厥。

translations.literal: Northern Zhou and Sui: subordinate to the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Northern Zhou and Sui it belonged to the Turks.

sentences.zh: 唐屬車鼻南境，為葛羅祿，後南徙，地屬黠戛斯。

translations.literal: Tang: part of the southern border of Chebi; it was Karluk; later they moved south and the land belonged to the Kirghiz.
translations.idiomatic: Under Tang it formed part of the southern border of Chebi and was Karluk territory; after the Karluks moved south, the land belonged to the Kirghiz.

sentences.zh: 後周時，貢於遼。

translations.literal: During Later Zhou, it paid tribute to Liao.
translations.idiomatic: During Later Zhou it paid tribute to Liao.

sentences.zh: 南宋為乃蠻國。

translations.literal: Southern Song: the Naiman state.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Southern Song it was the Naiman state.

sentences.zh: 元封諸王昔里吉。

translations.literal: Yuan: enfeoffed to Prince Xiliji.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was enfeoffed to Prince Xiliji.

sentences.zh: 明為土爾扈特部地，後屬準噶爾。

translations.literal: Ming: Torghut tribal territory; later subordinate to the Dzungars.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it was Torghut tribal territory; later it belonged to the Dzungars.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十二年，准部平，始內屬。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 22 the Dzungar department was pacified and it first became interior territory.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 22 the Dzungar department was pacified and the region first came under direct Qing control.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，築城雅爾，名曰肇豐。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year a city was built at Yar and named Zhaofeng.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 29 a city was built at Yar and named Zhaofeng.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，改築城於楚呼楚，距雅爾二百里。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year the city was rebuilt at Chuhuchu, two hundred li from Yar.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 31 the city was rebuilt at Chuhuchu, 200 li from Yar.

sentences.zh: 名曰綏靖，易其地名為塔爾巴哈台。

translations.literal: It was named Suijing and the place name was changed to Tarbagatai.
translations.idiomatic: It was named Suijing and the place name was changed to Tarbagatai.

sentences.zh: 設參贊大臣、協辦領隊大臣，專理游牧，領隊大臣各一，管糧理事、撫民同知，尋改通判，隸伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: A commissioner for affairs and an assistant brigade commander were established to manage nomadic affairs exclusively; one brigade commander each; a grain-affairs and civil-affairs subprefect and a people-pacifying subprefect; soon changed to magistrate; subordinate to the Ili commandant-general.
translations.idiomatic: A commissioner for affairs and an assistant brigade commander were appointed to manage nomadic affairs; one brigade commander was appointed for each role; subprefects for grain and civil affairs and for pacifying the people were established, soon converted to a magistrate; the subprefecture was placed under the Ili commandant-general.

sentences.zh: 光緒十四年，置直隸廳，改隸。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 14 a directly controlled subprefecture was established and its subordination was changed.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 14 a directly controlled subprefecture was established and its administrative subordination was changed.

sentences.zh: 於廳治東南里許築新城，改參贊大臣為左翼副都統。

translations.literal: A new city was built about a li southeast of the subprefecture seat, and the commissioner for affairs was changed to a left-flank vice commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: A new city was built about a li southeast of the subprefecture seat, and the commissioner for affairs was redesignated a left-flank vice commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 東南距省治一千六百二十四里。

translations.literal: One thousand six hundred twenty-four li southeast of the provincial seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 1,624 li southeast of the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 廣一千二百里，袤八百里。

translations.literal: One thousand two hundred li wide and eight hundred li long.
translations.idiomatic: It measures 1,200 li across and 800 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 北極高四十七度五分。

translations.literal: Northern latitude is forty-seven degrees five minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Its northern latitude is 47°5′.

sentences.zh: 京師偏西三十度三分。

translations.literal: Thirty degrees three minutes west of the capital meridian.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 30°3′ west of the capital meridian.

sentences.zh: 天山支脈，蜿蜒南部。

translations.literal: Branches of the Tianshan wind through the south.
translations.idiomatic: Branches of the Tianshan run winding through the south.

sentences.zh: 東：齋爾山、蘇海圖山、巴戛阿拉戛凌圖山。

translations.literal: East: Zhaier Mountain, Suhaitu Mountain, and Baga Alagalingtu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the east are Zhaier Mountain, Suhaitu Mountain, and Baga Alagalingtu Mountain.

sentences.zh: 東南：喀圖山。

translations.literal: Southeast: Katu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Katu Mountain.

sentences.zh: 西南：巴爾魯克山。

translations.literal: Southwest: Barluke Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Barluke Mountain.

sentences.zh: 東北：阿爾泰山、賽里山、和博沙克里山、芍隴山。

translations.literal: Northeast: Altai Mountain, Saili Mountain, Heboshakeli Mountain, and Shaolong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast are Altai Mountain, Saili Mountain, Heboshakeli Mountain, and Shaolong Mountain.

sentences.zh: 北：塔爾巴哈台山，支峰為毛海柯凌山、烏什嶺、額依賓山。

translations.literal: North: Tarbagatai Mountain; its subsidiary peaks are Maohai Keling Mountain, Wushi Ridge, and E'yibin Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Tarbagatai Mountain, with subsidiary peaks Maohai Keling Mountain, Wushi Ridge, and E'yibin Mountain.

sentences.zh: 額爾齊斯河自科布多部西流入，納哈布干諸水，西入俄界，瀦於齋桑淖爾。

translations.literal: The Irtysh River flows in from the west of the Kobdo department, receives the Habugan streams, flows west into Russian territory, and pools in Zaisan Lake.
translations.idiomatic: The Irtysh River enters from west of the Kobdo department, receives the Habugan streams, flows west into Russian territory, and pools in Zaisan Lake.

sentences.zh: 額敉勒河出額依賓山西麓，西流，至庫爾噶蘇台，合南源，西流，烏拉斯台水、烏宗戛拉水自俄境南流注之，博爾里河合察罕河北流注之，又東入俄境。

translations.literal: The Emin River emerges from the western foothills of E'yibin Mountain, flows west to Kue'ergasu Station, joins the southern source, flows west; Wulatai stream and Wuzongjiala stream flow south from Russian territory and pour into it; the Bo'erli River joins the Chahan River and flows north to pour into it; again eastward it enters Russian territory.
translations.idiomatic: The Emin River rises in the western foothills of E'yibin Mountain and flows west to Kue'ergasu Station, where it joins its southern source; flowing west it receives Wulatai stream and Wuzongjiala stream from Russian territory to the south, and the Bo'erli River joined with the Chahan River from the north; it then turns east into Russian territory.

sentences.zh: 和博克河出額依賓山東麓，東南流，合和博沙爾克河、巴杏薩拉水，又東南入昌吉，滲於沙。

translations.literal: The Heboke River emerges from the eastern foothills of E'yibin Mountain, flows southeast, joins the Hebosharke River and Baxingsala stream, again flows southeast into Changji, and seeps into sand.
translations.idiomatic: The Heboke River rises in the eastern foothills of E'yibin Mountain and flows southeast, receiving the Hebosharke River and Baxingsala stream; farther southeast it enters Changji and seeps into the sand.

sentences.zh: 蘇爾圖河出齋爾山，東流，會納木河，又東瀦為艾拉克淖爾。

translations.literal: The Su'ertu River emerges from Zhaier Mountain, flows east, meets the Namu River, and again east pools in Alak Lake.
translations.idiomatic: The Su'ertu River rises in Zhaier Mountain and flows east to meet the Namu River; farther east it pools in Alak Lake.

sentences.zh: 達爾達木河亦出齋爾山，東流，瀦為鹽池。

translations.literal: The Da'erdamu River also emerges from Zhaier Mountain, flows east, and pools in a salt lake.
translations.idiomatic: The Da'erdamu River also rises in Zhaier Mountain, flows east, and pools in a salt lake.

sentences.zh: 說爾噶其河亦出齋爾山，東南流，入綏來，瀦於阿爾雅淖爾。

translations.literal: The Shuo'ergaiqi River also emerges from Zhaier Mountain, flows southeast into Suilai, and pools in A'erya Lake.
translations.idiomatic: The Shuo'ergaiqi River also rises in Zhaier Mountain, flows southeast into Suilai, and pools in A'erya Lake.

translations.idiomatic: To the northeast are Haleiketao Mountain, Ice Mountain, Damusu'er Pass, and Mingbulake Mountain.

sentences.zh: 東南：截達坂，有滴水崖、溫巴什、托和奈旦、鞏伯、和色爾銅礦五。

translations.literal: Southeast: Jieda Pass, with five copper mines at Dishuiya, Wenbashi, Tuohenaidan, Gongbo, and Hesai'er.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Jieda Pass, with copper mines at Dishuiya, Wenbashi, Tuohenaidan, Gongbo, and Hesai'er.

sentences.zh: 木札拉提河，發源冰山，西南流，納鬧水、鐵敏水，折東南，納特拉布覺克水，為銅廠河。

translations.literal: The Muzhala River, sourced from Ice Mountain, flows southwest, receives Naoshui and Tiemin waters, turns southeast, receives Talabujueke water, and becomes the Copper Factory River.
translations.idiomatic: The Muzhala River rises at Ice Mountain and flows southwest, receiving the Naoshui and Tiemin streams; turning southeast and joined by the Talabujueke stream, it becomes the Copper Factory River.

sentences.zh: 又納哈拉蘇水、宿什勒克水，為渭干河，東南入庫車。

translations.literal: Further receiving the Halasu and Susheleke waters, it becomes the Weigan River and enters Kucha to the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: It then receives the Halasu and Susheleke streams, becomes the Weigan River, and flows southeast into Kucha.

sentences.zh: 驛五：姑墨、鄂伊斯塘、察爾齊、賽里木、河色爾。

translations.literal: Five post stations: Gumo, E'yisitang, Cha'erqi, Sailimu, and Hesai'er.
translations.idiomatic: Post stations number five: Gumo, E'yisitang, Cha'erqi, Sailimu, and Hesai'er.

sentences.zh: 回庄二十一。

translations.literal: Twenty-one Muslim villages.
translations.idiomatic: The county has twenty-one Muslim villages.

sentences.zh: 卡倫三。

translations.literal: Three barrier posts.
translations.idiomatic: There are three barrier posts.

sentences.zh: 焉耆府：要，沖，難。

translations.literal: Yanqi Prefecture: important, critical, difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Yanqi Prefecture: strategically important, critical, and difficult.

sentences.zh: 隸阿克蘇道。

translations.literal: Subordinate to the Aksu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: It is subordinate to the Aksu Circuit.

sentences.zh: 舊喀喇沙爾回城。

translations.literal: The old Karashahr Muslim city.
translations.idiomatic: It is the old Karashahr Muslim city.

sentences.zh: 喀喇譯言「黑」，沙爾「城」也。

translations.literal: Kara translates as "black," and Shar means "city."
translations.idiomatic: Kara means "black," and Shar means "city."

sentences.zh: 漢，焉耆、危須、尉犁諸國地。

translations.literal: Han: the lands of the states of Yanqi, Weixu, and Yuli.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Han it was the territory of Yanqi, Weixu, Yuli, and other states.

sentences.zh: 後漢至隋為焉耆國。

translations.literal: From Later Han through Sui it was the Yanqi state.
translations.idiomatic: From Later Han through the Sui it was the state of Yanqi.

sentences.zh: 唐貞觀六年來朝，十八年置焉耆都督府，後立碎葉鎮於此。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhenguan of Tang it came to court; in the eighteenth year the Yanqi Area Command was established, and later the Suyab Garrison was established here.
translations.idiomatic: In Tang Zhenguan 6 it sent tribute to court; in Zhenguan 18 the Yanqi Area Command was established, and later the Suyab Garrison was planted here.

sentences.zh: 貞元後，沒於吐蕃。

translations.literal: After the Zhenyuan era, lost to Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: After the Zhenyuan era it fell to Tibet.

sentences.zh: 宋西州回鶻地，後屬西遼。

translations.literal: Song: land of Xizhou Uyghurs; later subordinate to Western Liao.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song it was Uyghur territory of Xizhou; later it belonged to Western Liao.

sentences.zh: 元，別失八里東境。

translations.literal: Yuan: eastern border of Beshbalik.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it formed the eastern border of Beshbalik.

sentences.zh: 明初朝貢，後徙天山南，據其地，號伊勒巴拉。

translations.literal: Early Ming paid tribute; later moved south of the Tianshan, seized the land, and styled themselves Yilebala.
translations.idiomatic: In early Ming times it sent tribute; later its people moved south of the Tianshan, occupied the area, and styled themselves Yilebala.

sentences.zh: 康熙中，准部噶爾丹佔為牧場，小策凌敦多布、噶爾丹策零先後據之。

translations.literal: In the Kangxi era, Galdan of the Dzungars occupied it as pastureland; Tsewang Rabdan and Tsewang Arabtan held it in succession.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kangxi era Galdan of the Dzungars took it as pastureland; Tsewang Rabdan and Tsewang Arabtan held it in turn.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十二年，准部平，改名喀喇沙爾。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Qianlong the Dzungars were pacified and it was renamed Karashahr.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 22 the Dzungars were pacified and it was renamed Karashahr.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，始建城。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year a city was first built.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 23 a city was first built.

sentences.zh: 城毀於火。

translations.literal: The city was destroyed by fire.
translations.idiomatic: The city was destroyed by fire.

sentences.zh: 置府後，就安集延回城拓大之。

translations.literal: After establishing the prefecture, it was expanded from the Andijan Muslim city.
translations.idiomatic: After the prefecture was established, the city was enlarged from the Andijan Muslim quarter.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，設辦事大臣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year an affairs commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 24 an affairs commissioner was appointed.

sentences.zh: 轄布古爾、庫爾勒二城，設游擊，以阿奇木伯克理回務。

translations.literal: It governed the two cities of Bugur and Korla; a brigade commander was established, with an Akim beg managing Muslim affairs.
translations.idiomatic: It administered Bugur and Korla, with a brigade commander posted and an Akim beg appointed to manage Muslim affairs.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，土爾扈特及和碩特移牧珠勒都斯，歸辦事大臣兼轄。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year the Torghut and Khoshut moved their herds to Zhulduz, placed under the concurrent jurisdiction of the affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 38 the Torghut and Khoshut tribes moved their herds to Zhulduz and were placed under the affairs commissioner's concurrent jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 光緒八年裁，設喀喇沙爾直隸廳。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Guangxu it was abolished and the Karashahr Directly Controlled Subprefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 8 it was abolished and reorganized as the Karashahr Direct-Controlled Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十四年升府，易今名。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year it was promoted to a prefecture and given its present name.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 24 it was promoted to a prefecture and given its present name.

sentences.zh: 北距省一千九十里。

translations.literal: One thousand nine hundred ninety li north of the province.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 1,990 li north of the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 廣一千餘里，袤二千五百里。

translations.literal: More than one thousand li wide and two thousand five hundred li long.
translations.idiomatic: It measures more than 1,000 li across and 2,500 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 北極高四十二度七分。

translations.literal: Northern latitude is forty-two degrees seven minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Its northern latitude is 42°7′.

sentences.zh: 京師偏西二十九度十七分。

translations.literal: Twenty-nine degrees seventeen minutes west of the capital meridian.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 29°17′ west of the capital meridian.

sentences.zh: 領縣三。

translations.literal: It governs three counties.
translations.idiomatic: It administers three counties.

sentences.zh: 西：達蘭達坂、江布達坂、達哈特嶺。

translations.literal: West: Dalanda Pass, Jiangbu Pass, and Dahate Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: To the west are Dalanda Pass, Jiangbu Pass, and Dahate Ridge.

sentences.zh: 西北：胡斯圖達坂、澤達坂、察罕薩拉達坂、和屯博克嶺。

translations.literal: Northwest: Hustu Pass, Zeda Pass, Chahansala Pass, and Hetunboke Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest are Hustu Pass, Zeda Pass, Chahansala Pass, and Hetunboke Ridge.

sentences.zh: 北：硃勒都斯山。

translations.literal: North: Zhulduz Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Zhulduz Mountain.

sentences.zh: 東：博爾圖山、鐵里達坂、薩薩爾達坂。

translations.literal: East: Bo'ertu Mountain, Tieli Pass, and Sasar Pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the east are Bo'ertu Mountain, Tieli Pass, and Sasar Pass.

sentences.zh: 東南：庫爾泰山、大石山、干洛可達坂。

translations.literal: Southeast: Kuer'tai Mountain, Dashishi Mountain, and Ganluoke Pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast are Kuer'tai Mountain, Dashishi Mountain, and Ganluoke Pass.

sentences.zh: 開都河，源出和屯博克嶺，南流，經硃勒都斯山，分二支，復合扣克訥克水，折東南，納賽仁木諸小水；

translations.literal: The Kaidu River, sourced from Hetunboke Ridge, flows south, passes Zhulduz Mountain, divides into two branches, rejoins the Kekeneke water, turns southeast, and receives the Sairim and other small streams;
translations.idiomatic: The Kaidu River rises at Hetunboke Ridge and flows south past Zhulduz Mountain; dividing into two branches and rejoining the Kekeneke stream, it turns southeast and receives the Sairim and other minor waters;

sentences.zh: 南流逕城西，匯於博斯騰淖爾。

translations.literal: Flowing south past west of the city, it pools in Bosten Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Flowing south past the west of the city, it empties into Bosten Lake.

sentences.zh: 復溢出，逕庫爾勒回城，又匯為布它海子，入輪台。

translations.literal: It overflows again, passes Korla Muslim city, pools again as Buta Lake, and enters Luntai.
translations.idiomatic: Overflowing again, it passes Korla Muslim city, pools as Buta Lake, and enters Luntai.

sentences.zh: 崆吉斯河，源出城西北舉爾達坂，西北流，入寧遠。

translations.literal: The Kongjisi River, sourced from Ju'er Pass northwest of the city, flows northwest and enters Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: The Kongjisi River rises at Ju'er Pass northwest of the city, flows northwest, and enters Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 瑪納斯河，源出胡斯圖達坂，北流入綏來。

translations.literal: The Manas River, sourced from Hustu Pass, flows north and enters Suilai.
translations.idiomatic: The Manas River rises at Hustu Pass, flows north, and enters Suilai.

sentences.zh: 呼圖壁河，源出府北天格爾達坂，北流入昌吉。

translations.literal: The Huitubi River, sourced from Tiange'er Pass north of the prefecture, flows north and enters Changji.
translations.idiomatic: The Huitubi River rises at Tiange'er Pass north of the prefecture, flows north, and enters Changji.

sentences.zh: 驛九：在城、清水河、烏沙克塔、新井子、榆樹溝、柴泥泉、庫爾勒、上戶地、庫爾楚。

translations.literal: Nine post stations: Zaicheng, Qingshuihe, Wushaketa, Xinjingzi, Yushugou, Chainiquan, Korla, Shanghudi, and Ku'erchu.
translations.idiomatic: Post stations number nine: Zaicheng, Qingshuihe, Wushaketa, Xinjingzi, Yushugou, Chainiquan, Korla, Shanghudi, and Ku'erchu.

sentences.zh: 大回庄八。

translations.literal: Eight large Muslim villages.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture has eight large Muslim villages.

sentences.zh: 土爾扈特部兩札薩克、和碩特部兩札薩克游牧地。

translations.literal: Nomadic pastureland of two Torghut zasaks and two Khoshut zasaks.
translations.idiomatic: There is pasturage of two Torghut zasaks and two Khoshut zasaks.

sentences.zh: 卡倫五。

translations.literal: Five barrier posts.
translations.idiomatic: There are five barrier posts.

sentences.zh: 新平疲，難。

translations.literal: Xinping: strained, difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Xinping County: strained and difficult.

sentences.zh: 府南三百六十餘里。

translations.literal: More than three hundred sixty li south of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lies more than 360 li south of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 漢，尉犁國地。

translations.literal: Han: the land of the Yuli state.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Han it was the territory of the Yuli state.

sentences.zh: 三國後入焉耆。

translations.literal: After the Three Kingdoms it entered Yanqi.
translations.idiomatic: After the Three Kingdoms period it was absorbed into Yanqi.

sentences.zh: 明，後什尼戛地。

translations.literal: Ming: land of Houshenijia.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it was Houshenijia territory.

sentences.zh: 舊名羅布淖爾，屬魯克沁回王。

translations.literal: Formerly named Lop Nor, subordinate to the Lopnur Muslim king.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly called Lop Nor, it belonged to the Lopnur Muslim king.

sentences.zh: 光緒十一年，設局蒲昌城理屯防。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Guangxu a bureau was established at Puchang City to manage garrison farming and defense.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 11 a bureau was established at Puchang City to administer garrison farming and defense.

sentences.zh: 二十四年置縣，治羅布淖爾，以游擊駐蒲昌城。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year a county was established, with the seat at Lop Nor; a brigade commander was stationed at Puchang City.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 24 a county was established with its seat at Lop Nor, and a brigade commander was posted at Puchang City.

sentences.zh: 北：大石山支脈自府境迤邐入縣。

translations.literal: North: a branch of Dashishi Mountain winds into the county from the prefectural border.
translations.idiomatic: To the north a spur of Dashishi Mountain winds into the county from the prefectural border.

sentences.zh: 塔里木河自沙雅東流入，分二支，南支匯為小羅布淖爾，溢出東行，與北支合，渭干南河自沙雅東流注之，又東注為六泊。

translations.literal: The Tarim River enters from east of Shaya, divides into two branches; the southern branch pools as Little Lop Nor, overflows eastward, joins the northern branch, the southern Weigan River flows in from east of Shaya, and further east empties into the Six Lakes.
translations.idiomatic: The Tarim River enters from east of Shaya and divides into two branches; the southern branch pools as Little Lop Nor, overflows eastward, and rejoins the northern branch; the southern Weigan River flowing in from east of Shaya joins it, and farther east the waters empty into the Six Lakes.

sentences.zh: 渭干北河自輪台東流入，瀦為沖庫海子。

translations.literal: The northern Weigan River enters from east of Luntai and pools as Chongku Lake.
translations.idiomatic: The northern Weigan River enters from east of Luntai and pools as Chongku Lake.

sentences.zh: 孔雀河承布它海子水自府入，溢出東流，與沖庫海子溢出水合，東南流，入婼羌。

translations.literal: The Kongque River carries Buta Lake water from the prefecture, overflows eastward, joins overflow from Chongku Lake, flows southeast, and enters Ruoqiang.
translations.idiomatic: The Kongque River carries water from Buta Lake in the prefecture, overflows eastward, joins the overflow from Chongku Lake, flows southeast, and enters Ruoqiang.

sentences.zh: 古斯拉克河由塔里木河所瀦之第五泊溢出，東北流，斜貫渭干北河，為罕溪河，東北匯為小海子，入婼羌。

translations.literal: The Gusilake River overflows from the fifth lake pooled by the Tarim River, flows northeast, crosses the northern Weigan River diagonally, becomes the Hanxi River, pools northeast as Little Lake, and enters Ruoqiang.
translations.idiomatic: The Gusilake River overflows from the fifth pool formed by the Tarim River, flows northeast, cuts diagonally across the northern Weigan River as the Hanxi River, pools northeast as Little Lake, and enters Ruoqiang.

sentences.zh: 驛九：在城、克泥爾、英氣蓋河、楷拉、英格可立、烏魯可立、古斯拉克庄、哈什墩、都拉里。

translations.literal: Nine post stations: Zaicheng, Keni'er, Yingqigaihe, Kaila, Yinggekeli, Wulukeli, Gusilake Village, Hashidun, and Dulali.
translations.idiomatic: Post stations number nine: Zaicheng, Keni'er, Yingqigaihe, Kaila, Yinggekeli, Wulukeli, Gusilake Village, Hashidun, and Dulali.

sentences.zh: 回庄二十。

translations.literal: Twenty Muslim villages.
translations.idiomatic: The county has twenty Muslim villages.

sentences.zh: 卡倫三。

translations.literal: Three barrier posts.
translations.idiomatic: There are three barrier posts.

sentences.zh: 輪台沖，疲，難。

translations.literal: Luntai: critical, strained, difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Luntai County: critical, strained, and difficult.

sentences.zh: 府西南六百十五里。

translations.literal: Six hundred fifteen li southwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 615 li southwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 舊至古巡司。

translations.literal: Formerly the Zhigu patrol office.
translations.idiomatic: It was formerly the Zhigu patrol office.

sentences.zh: 漢，輪台、烏壘、渠犁。

translations.literal: Han: Luntai, Wulei, and Quli.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Han it was Luntai, Wulei, and Quli.

sentences.zh: 晉，龜茲國地。

translations.literal: Jin: Kucha territory.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Jin it was Kucha territory.

sentences.zh: 元魏後入吐谷渾。

translations.literal: After Northern Wei it entered Tuyuhun.
translations.idiomatic: After the Northern Wei it came under Tuyuhun.

sentences.zh: 唐屬安西都護，與于闐、疏勒、碎葉為四鎮，後陷吐蕃。

translations.literal: Tang: subject to the Anxi Protectorate; together with Yutian, Shule, and Suyab it formed the Four Garrisons; later it fell to Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it belonged to the Anxi Protectorate as part of the Four Garrisons alongside Yutian, Shule, and Suyab; later it was lost to Tibet.

sentences.zh: 元為別失八里東境。

translations.literal: Yuan: the eastern border of Bashibali.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was the eastern border of Bashibali.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中內附。

translations.literal: In the Qianlong reign it became interior territory.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qianlong reign it came under direct Qing control.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，設阿奇木伯克理回務。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year an Akim beg was appointed to manage Muslim affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 24 an Akim beg was appointed to administer Muslim affairs.

sentences.zh: 光緒八年裁，設巡司。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Guangxu it was abolished and a patrol commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 8 the post was abolished and a patrol commissioner was appointed.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，以布古爾置縣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year a county was established at Bugur.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 28 a county was established at Bugur.

sentences.zh: 北：珠勒土斯山，蜿蜒數百里。

translations.literal: North: Zhulduz Mountain, winding for several hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Zhulduz Mountain, winding for several hundred li.

sentences.zh: 的納爾河發源庫車之哈拉草湖，南流入境，納縣北諸水，又南流，匯為斯爾里克黑洗湖。

translations.literal: The Denar River rises at Hala Grass Lake in Kucha, flows south into the jurisdiction, receives the various streams of the county's north, flows south again, and pools as Sierlik Heixi Lake.
translations.idiomatic: The Denar River rises at Hala Grass Lake in Kucha, enters the county from the south, receives the northern streams, flows south again, and pools as Sierlik Heixi Lake.

sentences.zh: 渭干北河自沙雅東北流入，又東入新平。

translations.literal: The northern Weigan River enters from northeast of Shaya, then flows east into Xinping.
translations.idiomatic: The northern Weigan River enters from northeast of Shaya and flows east into Xinping.

sentences.zh: 東南：大戈壁。

translations.literal: Southeast: the Great Gobi.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast lies the Great Gobi.

sentences.zh: 驛四：布古爾、洋薩爾、策達雅爾、野雲溝。

translations.literal: Four post stations: Bugur, Yangsar, Cedaya'er, and Yeyungou.
translations.idiomatic: Post stations number four: Bugur, Yangsar, Cedaya'er, and Yeyungou.

sentences.zh: 回庄九十一。

translations.literal: Ninety-one Muslim villages.
translations.idiomatic: The county has ninety-one Muslim villages.

sentences.zh: 婼羌要。

translations.literal: Ruoqiang: important.
translations.idiomatic: Ruoqiang County: strategically important.

sentences.zh: 府東南一千二百餘里。

translations.literal: More than one thousand two hundred li southeast of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lies more than 1,200 li southeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 漢，婼羌國。

translations.literal: Han: the Ruoqiang state.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Han it was the state of Ruoqiang.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十四年，設阿奇木伯克理回務。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Qianlong an Akim beg was appointed to manage Muslim affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 24 an Akim beg was appointed to administer Muslim affairs.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十四年裁，設卡克里克縣丞，隸府。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu it was abolished; a Kakilik assistant magistrate was established, subordinate to the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 24 the post was abolished; a Kakilik assistant magistrate was appointed under the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十八年置縣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year a county was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 28 a county was established.

sentences.zh: 崑崙支脈亙於境內。

translations.literal: Branches of the Kunlun extend across the jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Kunlun spurs run across the jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 南：烏蘭達布遜山、阿勒騰塔格嶺、阿里哈屯山、大中小屈莽山。

translations.literal: South: Wulandabuxun Mountain, Aletengtage Ridge, Alihatun Mountain, and the large, medium, and small Qumang mountains.
translations.idiomatic: To the south are Wulandabuxun Mountain, Aletengtage Ridge, Alihatun Mountain, and the large, medium, and small Qumang mountains.

sentences.zh: 東：阿思騰塔格山。

translations.literal: East: Asitengtage Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Asitengtage Mountain.

sentences.zh: 孔雀河自新平東南入，分二支：一東流，瀦為孔雀海子；

translations.literal: The Kongque River enters from southeast of Xinping and divides into two branches: one flows east and pools as Kongque Lake;
translations.idiomatic: The Kongque River enters from southeast of Xinping and divides into two branches: one flows east and pools as Kongque Lake;

sentences.zh: 一合阿喇鐵里木河，至托乎沙塔庄，注羅布淖爾。

translations.idiomatic: In the Taikang era of Jin it was destroyed by Yanqi, then soon restored.

translations.literal: In the Zhenguan era of Tang the Kucha Area Command was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhenguan era of Tang the Kucha Area Command was established.

translations.idiomatic: During the Northern Song it sent tribute.

translations.idiomatic: Under the Southern Song it belonged to Western Liao.

translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was the western border of Bashibali.

translations.idiomatic: In the Yongle era of Ming it was incorporated into the Muslim regions.

sentences.zh: 順治、康熙間，準噶爾兼有其地。

translations.literal: In the Shunzhi and Kangxi reigns the Dzungars also held this territory.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shunzhi and Kangxi reigns the Dzungars also held this territory.

translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 23, during the campaign against Hodja Jahan, Beg Aji surrendered the city and it was renamed Kuche.

sentences.zh: 庫譯言「此地」，車謂「眢井」也。

translations.idiomatic: Ku means "this place," and Che means "abandoned well."

translations.idiomatic: A brigade vice-commander was appointed, with an Akim beg to administer Muslim affairs.

translations.idiomatic: It lies 2,030 li north of the provincial seat.

translations.idiomatic: It measures 610 li across and 700 li from north to south.

translations.idiomatic: Its northern latitude is 41°37′.

translations.literal: Thirty-three degrees thirty-two minutes west of the capital meridian.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 33°32′ west of the capital meridian.

sentences.zh: 領縣一。

translations.literal: It governs one county.
translations.idiomatic: It administers one county.

translations.literal: Branches of Khan Tengri Mountain extend across the northern border.
translations.idiomatic: Spurs of Khan Tengri Mountain stretch across the northern border.

sentences.zh: 東北有迭拉爾達坂。

translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Diela'er Pass.

sentences.zh: 西北：阿爾齊里克達坂、馬納克齊達坂、泰來買提達坂、阿拉阿奇達坂。

translations.literal: Northwest: A'erqilike Pass, Manakeqi Pass, Tailaimaiti Pass, and Ala'aqi Pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest are A'erqilike Pass, Manakeqi Pass, Tailaimaiti Pass, and Ala'aqi Pass.

sentences.zh: 西：托和拉旦達坂、千佛洞。

translations.literal: West: Tuoheladan Pass and the Thousand Buddha Caves.
translations.idiomatic: To the west are Tuoheladan Pass and the Thousand Buddha Caves.

translations.literal: North: the Subashi copper works.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Subashi copper works.

translations.literal: The Longkou River rises at Diela'er Pass, flows southwest, receives the Tarike, Tuokesula, Kalanor, and Duotuo waters, reaches Suilu Village, divides into the Yesibashi, Wuqiasayi, and Mi'erteyan rivers, joins and flows east, and pools as Shaharike Grass Lake.
translations.idiomatic: The Longkou River rises at Diela'er Pass and flows southwest, receiving the Tarike, Tuokesula, Kalanor, and Duotuo streams; at Suilu Village it divides into the Yesibashi, Wuqiasayi, and Mi'erteyan rivers, which reunite and flow east to pool as Shaharike Grass Lake.

sentences.zh: 拉依蘇河出城北，分二支，均南流，一入輪台，一入沙哈里克草湖。

translations.literal: The Layisu River emerges north of the city, divides into two branches, both flowing south; one enters Luntai and one enters Shaharike Grass Lake.
translations.idiomatic: The Layisu River rises north of the city and divides into two southern branches: one enters Luntai and the other Shaharike Grass Lake.

sentences.zh: 渭干河自拜城東南流入，逕千佛洞，南流入沙雅。

translations.literal: The Weigan River enters from southeast of Baicheng, passes the Thousand Buddha Caves, and flows south into Shaya.
translations.idiomatic: The Weigan River enters from southeast of Baicheng, passes the Thousand Buddha Caves, and flows south into Shaya.

translations.literal: Five post stations: Qiuci, Tuoheladan, Tuohenai, Ha'erba, and A'erbate.
translations.idiomatic: Post stations number five: Qiuci, Tuoheladan, Tuohenai, Ha'erba, and A'erbate.

sentences.zh: 大小回庄一百二十六。

translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 29 a county was established at the Shayar Muslim city.

translations.literal: Northwest: Hadianketao Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Hadianketao Mountain.

translations.idiomatic: The Weigan River enters from south of the prefecture, turns east to Sayabake Village, becomes the Egen River, passes Shakelike, and sends a branch south into the Tarim River.

translations.idiomatic: Farther east it passes Aqia and divides into two branches: one flows southeast out of the jurisdiction as the southern Weigan River into Xinping;

translations.literal: one flows northeast, leaving the jurisdiction as the northern Weigan River and entering Luntai.
translations.idiomatic: the other flows northeast out of the jurisdiction as the northern Weigan River into Luntai.

translations.idiomatic: The Tarim River enters from southeast of Wensu; at Keke'mi it receives a Weigan tributary, and at Kaladun it flows east into Xinping.

sentences.zh: 西南：下和裏海子。

translations.literal: Southwest: Xiaheli Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Xiaheli Lake.

translations.literal: West: Grass Lake Stream.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Grass Lake Stream.

translations.idiomatic: Post stations number two: Zaicheng and Liangga'er.

translations.literal: Sixty-four Muslim villages.

translations.idiomatic: There are three barrier posts.

translations.idiomatic: Under the Northern Wei it came under Kucha.

translations.literal: Southern Song: subject to Western Liao.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Southern Song it belonged to Western Liao.

translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was the western border of Bashibali, enfeoffed to Prince Azhiji.

translations.idiomatic: It is named after Wuchi Mountain.

translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 44 the brigade commander was transferred to Aksu.

translations.idiomatic: The Toshkan River has two sources: one enters from northeast of Payzawat, picks up the Shangqihar Pass stream, and flows east, receiving the Xibulekonggai and Yuzan rivers; at Ush Village the Biedie stream joins it from the south.

sentences.zh: 又東為畢底爾河、貢古魯及可可容二水合為柳樹泉，南流注之，東流入溫宿。

translations.literal: Farther east the Bidir River, and the Gongguru and Kekerong streams joining to form Willow Spring, flow south to join it, then flow east into Wensu.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east the Bidir River and the Gongguru and Kekerong streams, which unite as Willow Spring, flow south to join it before continuing east into Wensu.

translations.literal: Two post stations: Wuchi and Yanghai.
translations.idiomatic: Post stations number two: Wuchi and Yanghai.
