translations.literal: Formerly the Kashgar Circuit was at Laening City.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the Kashgar Circuit was based at Laening City.

sentences.zh: 喀什譯言「各色」，噶爾為「磚房」。

translations.literal: Kashi means "various colors," and Ga'er means "brick house."
translations.idiomatic: Kashi means "various colors," and ga'er means "brick house."

sentences.zh: 漢，疏勒國地。

translations.literal: Han: the land of the Shule state.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Han it was the territory of the state of Shule.

sentences.zh: 永平中，龜茲並之，尋復立。

translations.literal: In the Yongping era Kucha annexed it, but it was soon re-established.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongping era Kucha annexed it, but the state was soon restored.

sentences.zh: 元魏太延二年內屬。

translations.literal: Northern Wei, second year of Taiyan: interior territory.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiyan 2 of the Northern Wei it came under direct control.

sentences.zh: 隋末屬西突厥。

translations.literal: At the end of Sui it belonged to the Western Turks.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Sui it belonged to the Western Turks.

sentences.zh: 唐置佉沙都督府。

translations.literal: Tang established the Kasha Area Command.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang the Kasha Area Command was established.

sentences.zh: 宋開寶二年，並于于闐。

translations.literal: In the second year of Kaibao of Song it was annexed to Yutian.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaibao 2 of Song it was annexed to Yutian.

sentences.zh: 南宋屬西遼。

translations.literal: Southern Song: subject to Western Liao.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Southern Song it belonged to Western Liao.

sentences.zh: 元至元二十五年，置達魯花赤，屯田於此，隸阿母河省。

translations.literal: Yuan, twenty-fifth year of Zhiyuan: a darughachi was established and military colonies were placed here, subordinate to the Amu River Province.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 25 of the Yuan a darughachi was appointed, military colonies were established here, and the area was placed under the Amu River Province.

sentences.zh: 明為哈實哈兒國。

translations.literal: Ming: the state of Hashiha'er.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it was the state of Hashiha'er.

sentences.zh: 明末瑪木特玉布素自亞剌伯來。

translations.literal: At the end of Ming Mamut Yubusu came from Arabia.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Ming Mamut Yubusu came from Arabia.

sentences.zh: 奉回教。

translations.literal: He embraced Islam.
translations.idiomatic: He embraced Islam.

sentences.zh: 乾隆間，準噶爾汗囚其曾孫瑪罕木於伊犁，並其二子波羅泥都、霍集占。

translations.literal: In the Qianlong era the Dzungar khan imprisoned his great-grandson Mahmud at Ili, together with his two sons Burdan and Khoja Jahan.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qianlong era the Dzungar khan imprisoned his great-grandson Mahmud at Ili, together with his two sons Burdan and Khoja Jahan.

sentences.zh: 二十年，平伊犁，瑪罕木已死，定北將軍班第釋波羅泥都囚，使歸喀什噶爾統其眾，留霍集占于軍。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Ili was pacified; Mahmud was already dead; the Pacifier of the North, General Ban Di, released the prisoner Burdan and sent him back to Kashgar to rule his people, keeping Khoja Jahan with the army.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 20 Ili was pacified; Mahmud was already dead; General Ban Di, Pacifier of the North, released Burdan and sent him back to Kashgar to lead his people, while Khoja Jahan was kept with the army.

sentences.zh: 旋逃至葉爾羌，據城叛。

translations.literal: Soon he fled to Yarkand and seized the city in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: He soon fled to Yarkand, seized the city, and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，將軍富德克之，阿渾以喀什噶爾降，始內屬。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year General Fu De captured him; the Ahun surrendered Kashgar, and it first became interior territory.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 24 General Fu De captured him; the Ahun surrendered Kashgar, and the region first came under direct Qing control.

sentences.zh: 設參贊大臣，總辦天山南路八城事務。

translations.literal: An assistant commissioner was established to oversee affairs of the eight cities south of the Tianshan.
translations.idiomatic: An assistant commissioner was appointed to oversee the affairs of the eight cities south of the Tianshan.

sentences.zh: 以阿奇木伯克理回務。

translations.literal: An Akim beg was appointed to manage Muslim affairs.
translations.idiomatic: An Akim beg was appointed to administer Muslim affairs.

sentences.zh: 領隊大臣、協辦大臣各一。

translations.literal: One brigade commander and one co-assistant commissioner each.
translations.idiomatic: One brigade commander and one co-assistant commissioner were appointed.

sentences.zh: 專理喀什噶爾、英吉沙爾事務。

translations.literal: They were charged specifically with Kashgar and Yengisar affairs.
translations.idiomatic: They were charged specifically with the affairs of Kashgar and Yengisar.

sentences.zh: 總兵一。

translations.literal: One regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: One regional commander was posted.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，於沽漊巴海築徠寧城。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year Laening City was built at Guliebahi.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 27 Laening City was built at Guliebahi.

sentences.zh: 舊回城西北二里。

translations.literal: Two li northwest of the old Muslim city.
translations.idiomatic: It stood two li northwest of the old Muslim city.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，移參贊、協辦駐烏什，改設辦事大臣。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year the assistant commissioner and co-assistant commissioner were moved to Ush, and an affairs commissioner was established in their place.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 31 the assistant commissioner and co-assistant commissioner were transferred to Ush, and an affairs commissioner was appointed in their place.

sentences.zh: 五十二年，復設參贊、協辦。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year the assistant commissioner and co-assistant commissioner were re-established.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 52 the assistant commissioner and co-assistant commissioner were restored.

sentences.zh: 道光七年，於哈喇哈依築新城，名曰恢武。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Daoguang a new city was built at Halahayi, named Huiwu.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 7 a new city was built at Halahayi and named Huiwu.

sentences.zh: 光緒九年，裁參贊、協辦，置直隸州。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Guangxu the assistant commissioner and co-assistant commissioner were abolished and a directly controlled prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 9 the assistant commissioner and co-assistant commissioner were abolished and a direct-controlled prefecture was established.

sentences.zh: 二十九年升府，增伽師，又巴楚州同隸。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year it was promoted to a prefecture, Payzawat was added, and Bachu Prefecture was also placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 29 it was promoted to a prefecture, Payzawat was added, and Bachu Prefecture was also placed under its jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 尋割巴楚屬莎車。

translations.literal: Soon Bachu was detached and made subordinate to Shache.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Bachu was transferred to Shache Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 東北距省治四千五百里。

translations.literal: Four thousand five hundred li northeast of the provincial seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 4,500 li northeast of the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 廣一千六百餘里，袤七百餘里。

translations.literal: More than one thousand six hundred li wide and more than seven hundred li long.
translations.idiomatic: It measures more than 1,600 li across and more than 700 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 北極高三十九度二十五分。

translations.literal: Northern latitude is thirty-nine degrees twenty-five minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Its northern latitude is 39°25′.

sentences.zh: 京師偏西四十二度二十五分。

translations.literal: Forty-two degrees twenty-five minutes west of the capital meridian.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 42°25′ west of the capital meridian.

sentences.zh: 領縣二。

translations.literal: It governs two counties.
translations.idiomatic: It administers two counties.

sentences.zh: 烏蘭烏蘇河自府東流入，逕城南，復東北流入伽師。

translations.literal: The Ulan Usu River flows in from the east of the prefecture, passes south of the city, then flows northeast into Payzawat.
translations.idiomatic: The Ulan Usu River enters from east of the prefecture, passes south of the city, and then flows northeast into Payzawat.

sentences.zh: 罕愛里克河、雅璊雅爾河亦自府東流入，注岳普爾湖之東庫山河。

translations.literal: The Han'ailike River and the Yamanyar River also flow in from the east of the prefecture and empty into the Dongku River of Lake Yopur.
translations.idiomatic: The Han'ailike and Yamanyar rivers also enter from east of the prefecture and flow into the Dongku River of Lake Yopur.

sentences.zh: 下游別什幹渠，自英吉沙爾東北流入，分數小水入沙磧。

translations.literal: The downstream Bieshigan Canal flows in from northeast of Yengisar, divides into several small streams, and enters sandy desert.
translations.idiomatic: The downstream Bieshigan Canal enters from northeast of Yengisar, splits into several small streams, and sinks into the sandy desert.

sentences.zh: 驛三：系弦、雅璊雅爾、雅卜藏。

translations.literal: Three post stations: Xixian, Yamanyar, and Yabuzang.
translations.idiomatic: Post stations number three: Xixian, Yamanyar, and Yabuzang.

sentences.zh: 漢屯八，大小回庄六。

translations.literal: Eight Han military colonies and six large and small Muslim villages.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture has eight Han military colonies and six large and small Muslim villages.

sentences.zh: 布魯特部游牧地。

translations.literal: Nomadic pastureland of the Kyrgyz tribes.
translations.idiomatic: There is pasturage of the Kyrgyz tribes.

sentences.zh: 卡倫二。

translations.literal: Two barrier posts.
translations.idiomatic: There are two barrier posts.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，俄約定為商埠。

translations.literal: In Xianfeng 1, by treaty with Russia it was designated a treaty port.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 1 a treaty with Russia designated it a treaty port.

sentences.zh: 疏附沖，繁，疲。

translations.literal: Shufu: critical, busy, strained.
translations.idiomatic: Shufu County: critical, busy, and strained.

sentences.zh: 府西北二十四里。

translations.literal: Twenty-four li northwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lies twenty-four li northwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 舊回庄。

translations.literal: An old Muslim village.
translations.idiomatic: It was formerly a Muslim village.

sentences.zh: 光緒九年，劃烏蘭烏蘇河上游十一庄置。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Guangxu eleven villages on the upper Ulan Usu River were detached to establish it.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 9 it was established from eleven villages on the upper Ulan Usu River.

sentences.zh: 西北：烏孜別里山，為怱嶺、天山之過脈，蔥嶺支峰。

translations.literal: Northwest: Wuzibieli Mountain, a connecting range of the Pamirs and Tianshan, a branch peak of the Pamirs.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Wuzibieli Mountain, a connecting range between the Pamirs and the Tianshan and a branch peak of the Pamirs.

sentences.zh: 西南：喀喇特山、瑪爾幹山、喀卜喀山、額依爾阿特山。

translations.literal: Southwest: Kalate Mountain, Margan Mountain, Kabuka Mountain, and Eyi'er'ate Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest are Kalate Mountain, Margan Mountain, Kabuka Mountain, and Eyi'er'ate Mountain.

sentences.zh: 南：烏魯瓦特山、阿依阿奇山、勒泰烏巴什山，皆在烏蘭烏蘇河南，天山支峰。

translations.literal: South: Uluwat Mountain, Aiyi'aqi Mountain, and Letai'ubashi Mountain, all south of the Ulan Usu River, branch peaks of the Tianshan.
translations.idiomatic: To the south are Uluwat Mountain, Aiyi'aqi Mountain, and Letai'ubashi Mountain, all south of the Ulan Usu River and branch peaks of the Tianshan.

sentences.zh: 西北：薩瓦雅爾德山、西康山、克子圖山、庫斯渾山、東克依克山，皆在烏蘭烏蘇河北。

translations.literal: Northwest: Sawayarde Mountain, Xikang Mountain, Kezitu Mountain, Kusihun Mountain, and Dongkeyike Mountain, all north of the Ulan Usu River.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest are Sawayarde Mountain, Xikang Mountain, Kezitu Mountain, Kusihun Mountain, and Dongkeyike Mountain, all north of the Ulan Usu River.

sentences.zh: 烏蘭烏蘇河源出蔥嶺，東流，納業金水、瑪爾堪蘇河、阿依阿奇水、庫斯渾水，逕城西南，一支渠東流入府，一東流，圖蘇克塔什河合察克瑪克河北來注之，入伽師。

translations.literal: The Ulan Usu River rises in the Pamirs and flows east, receiving the Yejin stream, the Markansu River, the Aiyi'aqi stream, and the Kusihun stream; passing southwest of the city, one branch canal flows east into the prefecture, while another flows east; the Tusuketashi River together with the Chakmake River joins it from the north, and it enters Payzawat.
translations.idiomatic: The Ulan Usu River rises in the Pamirs and flows east, receiving the Yejin stream, Markansu River, Aiyi'aqi stream, and Kusihun stream; passing southwest of the city, one branch canal flows east into the prefecture while another continues east; the Tusuketashi River and the Chakmake River join it from the north before it enters Payzawat.

sentences.zh: 雅璊雅爾河自蒲犁北流入，東北出，一支渠入府。

translations.literal: The Yamanyar River flows in from north of Puli, exits to the northeast, and one branch canal enters the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Yamanyar River enters from north of Puli, flows out to the northeast, and sends one branch canal into the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 驛一，在城。

translations.literal: One post station: at the city.
translations.idiomatic: There is one post station at the city.

sentences.zh: 回庄九。

translations.literal: Nine Muslim villages.
translations.idiomatic: The county has nine Muslim villages.

sentences.zh: 布魯特五部游牧地：曰胡什齊，曰沖巴噶什，曰岳瓦什，曰希布察克，曰奈曼。

translations.literal: Nomadic pastureland of five Kyrgyz tribes: called Khushqi, Chongbaghsh, Yuewashi, Xibuchake, and Naiman.
translations.idiomatic: There is pasturage of five Kyrgyz tribes: Khushqi, Chongbaghsh, Yuewashi, Xibuchake, and Naiman.

sentences.zh: 卡倫三十三。

translations.literal: Thirty-three barrier posts.
translations.idiomatic: There are thirty-three barrier posts.

sentences.zh: 牌博自西南烏孜別里山豁，至東北帖列克山豁，凡二十二。

translations.literal: Boundary markers from the Wuzibieli Mountain pass in the southwest to the Tielieke Mountain pass in the northeast, twenty-two in all.
translations.idiomatic: From the Wuzibieli Mountain pass in the southwest to the Tielieke Mountain pass in the northeast, there are twenty-two boundary markers in all.

sentences.zh: 伽師沖，繁，難。

translations.literal: Payzawat: critical, busy, difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Payzawat County: critical, busy, and difficult.

sentences.zh: 府東一百六十里。

translations.literal: One hundred sixty li east of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 160 li east of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 漢，疏勒國地。

translations.literal: Han: the land of the Shule state.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Han it was the territory of the state of Shule.

sentences.zh: 唐，佉沙城。

translations.literal: Tang: Kasha city.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it was Kasha city.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十四年，設阿奇木伯克理回務。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Qianlong an Akim beg was established to manage Muslim affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 24 an Akim beg was appointed to administer Muslim affairs.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十九年，以牌素巴特回庄置。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year of Guangxu it was established from the Muslim village of Paisubate.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 29 it was established from the Muslim village of Paisubate.

sentences.zh: 天山支脈迤邐北境。

translations.literal: Branch ranges of the Tianshan wind along the northern border.
translations.idiomatic: Branch ranges of the Tianshan wind along the county's northern border.

sentences.zh: 北：郭克阿勒山、以格孜達坂、阿奇克山、依提約爾山。

translations.literal: North: Guoke'ale Mountain, Yigezi Pass, Aqiqi Mountain, and Yitiyue'er Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the north are Guoke'ale Mountain, Yigezi Pass, Aqiqi Mountain, and Yitiyue'er Mountain.

sentences.zh: 西北：依得朗山、倫郭斯山。

translations.literal: Northwest: Yidelang Mountain and Lengesi Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest are Yidelang Mountain and Lengesi Mountain.

sentences.zh: 東：蘇潭山。

translations.literal: East: Sutan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Sutan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 烏蘭烏蘇河自境及疏附分支東流入境，逕城北，喀什噶爾河南流注之。

translations.literal: The Ulan Usu River and a branch from Shufu flow east into the jurisdiction, pass north of the city, and the Kashgar River flows south to join it.
translations.idiomatic: The Ulan Usu River and a branch from Shufu enter from the east, pass north of the city, and are joined from the south by the Kashgar River.

sentences.zh: 又東北為二支，瀦為草湖，溢出復合，流入巴楚。

translations.literal: Farther northeast it divides into two branches, pools into a grass lake, overflows and rejoins, and flows into Bachu.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northeast it splits into two branches, pools in a grass lake, overflows and reunites, and then flows into Bachu.

sentences.zh: 驛五：在城、英阿瓦特、龍口橋、雅素里克、玉代里克。

translations.literal: Five post stations: Zaicheng, Ying'awate, Longkou Bridge, Yasulike, and Yudailike.
translations.idiomatic: Post stations number five: Zaicheng, Ying'awate, Longkou Bridge, Yasulike, and Yudailike.

sentences.zh: 大回庄五。

translations.literal: Five large Muslim villages.
translations.idiomatic: The county has five large Muslim villages.

sentences.zh: 卡倫八。

translations.literal: Eight barrier posts.
translations.idiomatic: There are eight barrier posts.

sentences.zh: 牌博自西北黑皮恰克，至烏圖魯達坂，凡五。

translations.literal: Boundary markers from Heipiqia in the northwest to Wutulu Pass, five in all.
translations.idiomatic: From Heipiqia in the northwest to Wutulu Pass, there are five boundary markers in all.

sentences.zh: 莎車府：沖，繁，難。

translations.literal: Shache Prefecture: critical, busy, difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Shache Prefecture: critical, busy, and difficult.

sentences.zh: 隸喀什噶爾道。

translations.literal: Subordinate to the Kashgar Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: It is subordinate to the Kashgar Circuit.

sentences.zh: 副將駐。

translations.literal: A deputy general is stationed.
translations.idiomatic: A deputy general is stationed there.

sentences.zh: 舊葉爾羌回城。

translations.literal: Formerly the Yarkand Muslim city.
translations.idiomatic: It was formerly the Muslim city of Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 葉爾譯言「地」，羌謂「寬廣」也。

translations.literal: "Ye'er" translates as "land," and "qiang" means "broad and spacious."
translations.idiomatic: "Ye'er" means "land," and "qiang" means "broad and spacious."

sentences.zh: 漢，莎車國地。

translations.literal: Han, Shache state territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the Han it was the territory of the state of Shache.

sentences.zh: 後漢並于于闐，元和後內附。

translations.literal: Later Han merged into Yutian; after Yuanhe it submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Later Han it was annexed by Yutian; after the Yuanhe era it came within the empire.

sentences.zh: 三國屬疏勒。

translations.literal: Three Kingdoms belonged to Shule.
translations.idiomatic: During the Three Kingdoms it belonged to Shule.

sentences.zh: 北魏為渠沙國，後疏勒並之。

translations.literal: Northern Wei was the state of Qusha; later Shule annexed it.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Northern Wei it was the state of Qusha; Shule later annexed it.

sentences.zh: 隋、唐至宋皆屬于闐。

translations.literal: Sui, Tang through Song all belonged to Yutian.
translations.idiomatic: From the Sui and Tang through the Song it belonged to Yutian.

sentences.zh: 南宋屬西遼。

translations.literal: Southern Song belonged to Western Liao.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Southern Song it belonged to Western Liao.

sentences.zh: 元曰雅兒看，以封宗王阿魯忽。

translations.literal: Yuan called it Yar-khan, enfeoffed to imperial clansman Arugh.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was called Yar-khan and granted to the imperial prince Arugh.

sentences.zh: 明曰葉爾羌，國最強。

translations.literal: Ming called it Yarkand; the state was strongest.
translations.idiomatic: In the Ming it was called Yarkand, and the state was the most powerful in the region.

sentences.zh: 順治十三年，哈密、吐魯番入貢，其表均葉爾羌阿布都剌汗署名。

translations.literal: Shunzhi thirteenth year, Hami and Turfan paid tribute; their memorials all bore the signature of Yarkand's Abudula Khan.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 13 Hami and Turfan paid tribute, and their memorials all bore the signature of Abudula Khan of Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十五年，破準噶爾，其王來朝，尋為準噶爾所阻。

translations.literal: Kangxi thirty-fifth year, defeated the Dzungars; its king came to court, soon blocked by the Dzungars.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 35 the Dzungars were defeated and its king came to court, but he was soon blocked by the Dzungars from returning.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十年，始內屬。

translations.literal: Qianlong twentieth year, first came within.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 20 it first came under direct Qing control.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，平霍集占，舊伯克回民以城降。

translations.literal: Twenty-fourth year, pacified Huo Jizhan; old begs and Muslim people surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 24 Huo Jizhan was suppressed, and the former begs and Muslim inhabitants surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，設辦事大臣、協辦大臣、兼領隊事務各一，副將一。

translations.literal: Twenty-sixth year, established affairs commissioner, co-assistant commissioner, and combined team leader each one, deputy general one.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 26 an affairs commissioner, a co-assistant commissioner, and a combined team leader were each appointed, along with one deputy general.

sentences.zh: 道光八年，改參贊大臣，尋復舊制。

translations.literal: Daoguang eighth year, changed to assistant commissioner; soon restored old system.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 8 the post was changed to assistant commissioner, but the previous arrangement was soon restored.

sentences.zh: 光緒八年平回亂。

translations.literal: Guangxu eighth year pacified Muslim rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 8 the Muslim rebellion was suppressed.

sentences.zh: 九年，裁辦事、領隊大臣。
